tei:div.tei:p: (kha)༄༅// paṇ+ḍi ta ma ti nas brgyud pa'i 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du// ār+ya mañdzu shrī sā dha ni nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo// skyabs 'gro byang chub sems bskyed tshad med bsgom// sngags 'di brjod la mi dmigs ngang la bzhag /oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las bam̐ pam̐ a dkar las// rgya mtsho'i steng du pad+ma zla ba bsam// de steng rang sems a dkar nyid gyur las// 'od 'phros don byas 'dus pas lhar gyur te// zhal gcig phyag gnyis mchog sbyin ut+pal bsnams// rdo rje'i skyil krung 'od zer rab 'phro ba// dar dkar na bza' rin chen rgyan gyis spras// ston zla'i mdog can lang tsho ldan par bsgom// oṃ wā kye dam̐ na maḥ rig sngags rgyal po 'bum phrag gcig gis 'grub// zla ba gcig gis blo 'phel rig pa 'dzin// dngos sam rmi lam nyid du mthong thos shing*// grub pa'i mtshan ma gzhan yang snang bar 'gyur// snying dbus zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rtsibs drug la// 'bru drug yi ge bkod pa g.yas g.yon bskor// shugs drag rtse mo rno zhing rab dkar bas// nyes 'joms stobs ldan myur 'dzin rab gsal 'gyur// gre phug aḥdakar dag las 'od 'phros pas// rgyal ba kun gyi blo gros dpag med dag /bsdus nas khong du thim pas lus khengs nas// mi brjed dran pa'i gzungs ni thob par 'gyur// yang na ral gri nyid bzung rig 'dzin 'gyur// nyi zla gzas zin dus su mā shā nyid// dar dkar gyis dril lce 'og bcug la bzla// myu gu byung gyur de ni grub pa yin// pha rol phyin dang bstod pa mang po dang*// mtshan nas brjod dang bstod pa mang po dang*// maṇ+ḍal dbul zhing gsol ba btab par bya// 'di yis myur du 'grub par 'gyur ba yin// 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs zab pa las kyang ches zab pa/

slob dpon chen po sgeg pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya shrī dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba gnubs byams pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba'o// ༈ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mañdzu shrī stot+t+ra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal la bstod pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo// don zab sngags kyi stobs kyis rab sbyangs zhing*// stong gsal nam mkha' dang mtshungs dri med la// pam̐ yig las grub dkar dwangs bdud rtsi'i mtsho// gting zab yangs pa can la phyag 'tshal lo// mtsho mtha' glang chen thal dkar gyis bskor zhing*// mnyen lcug 'khril sdem pad zlum drwa bas khyab// lo ma'i khur lding dkar mdzes me tog las// yid 'phrog dri bsung ldan la phyag 'tshal lo// mtsho chen dbus su pam̐ yig las byung ba'i// pad sdong yal ga lo ma phun tshogs mdzes// 'dab rgyas dkar gsal ge sar dmar ser can// lte ba ljang ser mtho la phyag= /de steng yi ge mchog rab yongs gyur las// rab zlum 'khor lo rnam dag phun tshogs mdzes// shin tu mdog dkar ri bong 'dzin gzugs can// bsil zer phyogs bcur 'gyed la phyag 'tshal lo// der bzhugs a dkar las byung dpa' bo'i sku// zung bzhi'i na tshod rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// chu shel dri med dang mtshungs rab dkar dwangs// mtshan mchog dpe byad 'bar la phyag= /thor tshugs rtse na rin chen tog gis mdzes// rtse mo lnga ldan zur phud shin tu gsal// snyan gong ut+pal dri ldan dar dpyangs 'phur// snyan shal nor bu 'phyang la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin mgul rgyan dpung rgyan phyag gdub dang*// zhabs gdub ska rags do shal bzang po las// sna tshogs na bza' rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes// sil sil sgra snyan 'khrol la phyag= /phyag g.yas mchog sbyin legs par brkyangs mdzad cing*// g.yon pas ut+pal sdong bu thugs kar 'dzin// srab 'jam dung mdog na bzas rnam mdzes pa'i// mu med 'od zer 'phro la phyag=

/dpal mchog sku yi rnam pa dran gyur nas// rig sngags cung zad bzlas pa tsam gyis kyang*// dus der dar dkar mā shā'i sbyor ba yis// phun tshogs blo gros 'phel la phyag 'tshal lo// gzhan yang gzhon nu dpa' bo legs bsten pa'i// ting 'dzin sngags dang sna tshogs rdzas sbyor gyis// gnas skabs mthar thugs yon tan ma lus pa// bslu med nges par 'grub la phyag 'tshal lo// ngo bo ma nor chos nyid rab mkhyen cing*// rnam pa ma lus chos can lhang nger gzigs// thugs rje che dang thabs tshul dpag med kyis// srid mtsho mtha' yas skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jam dbyangs mgon khyod gus pas rjes dran zhing*// bsgom bzlas legs mchod mngon par bstod pa yis// blo ngan ma rig 'thibs po'i tshogs rnams kun// sprin med nyi shar ji bzhin dwangs par mdzod// ces pa 'jig rten na mkhas pa rnams kyi nang nas rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo ltar mngon par mtho zhing gsal bar gyur pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta ma tis 'jam pa'i dbyangs la bstod pa/ sgrub thabs bskyed rim dang mthun par mdzad pa rdzogs so// ༈ /'di'i lo rgyus ni/ dze tā ri dgra las rnam par rgyal ba'i zhabs de 'jam dpal las chos dngos su gsan cing grub pa brnyes pa yin/ lan rig 'jam dbyangs byon nas da lta khyod kyis mi lo brgyad dang bcu lon// da bcu las lus 'dis mi thub pas snod dang ldan pa'i bu gcig tshol la nga'i chos 'di ston la chig brgyud kyis shod gsungs nas lung bstan/ der dze tā ri dgra las rnam par rgyal ba rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la 'phur te phyogs kun tu snod ldan gyi bu btsal bas ma rnyed/ slar ma ga dhā'i yul du gzigs pas ma he'i rdzi bo rgas shing 'khogs pa 'tsho ba dang bral ba gcig 'dug pa de snod ldan du gzigs nas der byon te/ khyod snod dang ldan par 'dug pas las 'di bshol la chos sgor zhugs shig gsungs pas/

de na re bdag rgas shing 'khogs la 'tsho ba'ang med/ yi ge'ang mi shes pas tshe phyi ma la rjes su bzung bar zhu zer/ der slob dpon gyis thabs yod gsungs nas sgrub thabs 'di byin te/ bsgrubs pas zhag bdun nas chos thams cad rang grol du shes pa'i paṇ+ḍi tar gyur te/ paṇ+ḍi ta ma ti zhes grags so// der slob dpon gyis 'jam dpal zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur te/ gsang mtshan sgeg pa'i rdo rje zhes grags so// nor bu gling du sku 'khrungs pas nor bu gling pa zhes grags so// de nas slob dpon la phyag byas nas slob dpon gyis bdag rjes su bzung bas mkhas par gyur kyang nga rgas pas bshad pa byed mi khom sgrub pa zhig byed zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas khyod rang la tshe lhag po lo bcu yod pa dang nga la yi dam gyi lung bstan thob pas lo bcu yod pa las gnyis 'das/ da lo brgyad yod pas khyod la sbyin gyis lo bco brgyad bar du 'gro don gyis/ de nas yi dam la gsol ba thob dang tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa 'ong srid gsungs nas slob dpon mkha' spyod du gshegs so// de nas sgeg pa'i rdo rjes nor bu gling pa chung ba la bshad/ des 'byung gnas sbas pa la gsungs/ des paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya shrī la gnang*/ khong bod du khro phu lo tsā bas gdan drangs nas/ dbus kyi srin po rir dbyar gnas mdzad pa'i dus su/ bod rnams kyis rgya gar gyi shes rab ma do nas/ khro phu lo tsā bas bla ma la shes rab 'phel ba'i gdams ngag zhus pas/ paṇ+ḍi ta'i gsung nas nga la gdams pa rgya mtsho tsam yod pa'i nang nas gdams pa khyad par can bzhi yod/ bde mchog dkar po la brten nas byang chub sgrub pa dang*/ 'jam dpal dkar po labarten nas blo 'phel ba dang*/ yang dag me gcig thod gcig la brten nas ras thub pa dang*/ dzam bha la nag po la brten nas nor sgrub pa dang bzhi las/ 'di 'jam dpal dkar po'i blo 'phel yin gsungs nas thams cad la gnang*/

bde mchog dang*/ dzam bha la'i bka' rjes gnang zhu na khyod rang bal yul du 'gro na ngas byed gsungs nas/ der khro phu lo tsā bas bal yul thug par skyel thung byas nas zhus pas/ der mi khom gsungs nas ma gnang*/ der khro phu lo tsā bas yang yang gsol ba btab nas zhus pas/ khyod de tsam du gdung sems che na sbyin gyis gsungs nas gnang ba yin/ paṇ+ḍi tas dbu snyung bzhes pa'i gdams pa yin no gsungs/

khro phu lo tsā ba la mkhan po dbang phyug seng ges zhus/ des rgya ston ā nan+da bdag la'o// 'di'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod pas maṇ+ḍal dpe'u chung ltar bris la dbus su mtshan brjod dang 'jam dpal gyi sku bzhugs/ mthar mchod pas bskor/ dkar gtor gcig bsham/ de nas slob dpon gyis mngon rtogs nas 'byung ba bzhin rang 'jam dpal du bskyed la/ bzlas pa mchod bstod yan lag bdun pa bya/ gtor ma de a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twata oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta mañdzu shrī ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes brjod pas ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar bsams la mchod bstod bya/ de nas slob ma rnams kyis maṇ+ḍal phul la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// sogs gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs kyi rgyun bshags/ de nas khyad par gyi gsol gdab gang yang rung ba'i sgo nas yan lag bdun pa byed du gzhug de'i rjes su rjes gnang sbyin te/ sku'i rjes gnang lus la bskur ba dang*/ gsung gi rjes gnang ngag la bskur ba dang*/ thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i rjes gnang sems la bskur ba dang*/ yon tan dang phrin las gnyis kyi rjes gnang lus sems gnyis ka la bskur ba'o// dang po sku'i rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ gang tshe blta bar 'dod pa'am// cung zad 'dri bar 'dod na yang*// mgon po 'jam dbyangs de nyid ni// gegs med par ni mthong bar shog /ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ de nas 'jam dpal gyi sku slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ khyod rang 'jam dpal du bsgoms pa'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu 'jam dpal cig byon nas/ sku la thim par sgoms shig ces brjod la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku che ba// sangs rgyas kun gyi sku yin te// sangs rgyas sku yis byin brlabs pas// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku thob shog

/dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas slob ma dang 'jam dpal gnyis su med par bsam/ de la phan yon gnyis te gnas skabs su nad med pa dang*/ mthong ba tsam gyis 'gro ba dad pa dang*/ mthar thug mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i 'jam dpal gyi sku thob par 'gyur ro// de nas gsung gi rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ brtse ldan khyod kyi mkhyen rab 'od zer gyis// bdag blo'i gti mug mun pa rab bsal te// bka' dang bstan bcos gzhung lugs rtogs pa yi// blo gros spobs pa'i snang ba bskyed du gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba 'debs so// de nas dpon slob gnyis ka 'jam dpal du bskyed la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'od zer zhal nas thon slob ma'i khar zhugs snying gar thim par bsams la/ phreng ba gtad la sngags kyi rjes zlos byed du gzhug de la phan yon gnyis te/ gnas skabs su 'chad rtsod rtsom pa la mkhas pa dang*/ mthar thug gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu thob par 'gyur ro// de nas thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ shes pas srid la mi gnas shing*// snying rjes zhi la mi gnas pa// mya ngan 'das dang 'khor mi gnas// 'jam dbyangs thugs la gsol ba 'debs// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab bo// de nas slob ma rnams rkang pa skyil krung*/ lag pa mnyam bzhag sgal tshigs bsrang*/ mig bar snang la gtad/ nam mkha' la a dkar po gcig bsams la/ a nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod/ a de'ang me long la has btab pa bzhin du mi dmigs par ci yang yid la mi byed pa'i ngang la bzhag go /de nas slob ma'i spyi bor me tog bzhag la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod pas brtan par bya'o// de la phan yon gnyis te/ gnas skabs su chos la blo 'gro zhing*/ mthar thug shes bya ji lta ba dang*/ ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin thob par 'gyur ro// de nas yon tan dang phrin las kyi rjes gnang ni/

dang por gsol ba gdab ste/ dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// phyi ma byang chub ma thob bar// bcom ldan 'jam dbyangs mgon gyis ni// bdag gi bla mar mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ de nas slob ma'i lag tu mtshan brjod gtad la rjes gnang sbyin no// de la phan yon gnyis te gnas skabs su rig pa'i gnas thams cad la mkhas shing sems can gyi don 'grub pa dang*/ mthar thug 'jam dpal la mnga' ba'i yon tan phrin las dang mnyam par 'gyur ro// gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas sogs/ rjes kyi bya ba rnams spyi dang 'dra bar mdzad do// de nas bsngo ba ni/ 'di bsgrub pa las byung ba yi// dge ba bdag gis gang thob pa// des ni skye bo thams cad kyis// bde gshegs shes rab thob par shog /de nas bzod par gsol/ gtor ma gtsang sar bskyal/ dkyil 'khor bsdu/ bkra shis brjod/ 'jam dpal dkar po'i rjes gnang gi cho ga paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī'i phyag len ji lta bar lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis bsdebs pa'o// sarba dā maṅga laṃ// ༈ /'jam dpal dkar po'i rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs dang las kha tshar bzhi bcas bzhugs so// shin tu dkar ba'i mdangs ldan mtsho yi dbus na pad+mo'i ge sar gyi// sdong por 'khrungs shing ri bong 'dzin pa'i steng na rje btsun 'jam dbyangs ni// gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs gangs ri dang mtshungs pa// zhal gcig phyag gnyis mchog sbyin ut+pal legs bsnams 'jam dbyangs khyod la 'dud// de ltar bstod nas de yi sgrub thabs cho ga ni// mkhas pa'i rjes 'brang bdag gis gsal bar bshad par bya/ de la gnyis te/ rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs dang las phran tshegs bstan pa'o// dang po la bzhi/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi lha bskyed pa/ bzlas pa bya ba/ rjes kyi bya ba'o// dang po tshad med pa bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ sems can thams cad kyi gti mug gi mun pa bsal la shes rab kyi snang ba la bkod/

de'i ched du 'jam dpal bsgrub snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de nas snang srid brtan g.yo'i chos thams cad swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis stong par bsgom pa sngon 'gro'o// dngos gzhi lha bskyed pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las rgya mtsho dkar zhing yangs pa mtha' ne'u gsing gis brgyan pa'i steng na glang po che sna tshogs gnas pa mtsho steng me tog sna tshogs bkra ba'i steng na/ chu bya skad snyan par sgrogs pas brgyan pa/ de'i dbus su pam̐ ljang ser las pad+ma'i sdong po yal ga dang lo ma gser las byas pa/ 'dab ma rgyas pa/ dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad ge sar dmar ser du yod pa'i steng na a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang la/ de'i dbus su rang gi sems nyid a dkar po zhig tu gyur/ de las dpag tu med pa'i 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa rnams mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi gti mug gi sgrib pa sbyangs/ shes rab kyi snang ba la bkod/ 'od zer tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'jam dpal sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon ut+pa la'i yu ba thugs kar 'dzin zhing snyan gyi thad kar kha gyes pa'i steng na stong phrag brgya pa'i pusti 'dzin pa/ zhabs skyil krung gis bzhugs shing*/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ brgyad gnyis lon pa'i na tshod tsam du bsgom par bya'o// bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi snying gi rtse mo gyen du bstan pa'i dbus su 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs drug pa/ lte ba la a/ rtsibs drug la mdun gyi phyogs nas brtsams te yi ge drug bkod la 'khor lo la ma reg pa'i tshul gyis g.yar skor du bsam/ de nas 'khor lo g.yas la yig 'bru g.yon du bskor zhing sdig sgrib thams cad sangs sangs dag par bsam zhing*/ oṃ wā kye dam̐ na maḥ zhes 'bum tsho gsum bzlas pa ni grangs kyi bsnyen pa'o// zla ba gcig gi bsnyen pa ni dus kyi bsnyen pa'o// zhal mthong zhing gsung thos pa'am/

gzhan yang pusti dang mtshon cha thogs pa dang*/ me tog btus pa dang*/ mar me bltams pa/ nyi zla shar ba dang*/ dar 'phyar zhing rol mo 'bud dkrol byed pa/ nam mkha' la 'phur ba dang*/ lus la me 'bar ba dang*/ chu brgal ba dang*/ gos dkar po gyon pa la sogs pa rmis na mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa yin no// rjes la bya ba ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya mañdzu shrī ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas yon chab/ puṣ+pes me tog dhu pes bdug spos/ ā lo kes mar me/ gan+dhes dri chab/ nai wi d+yas zhal zas/ shab+das rol mo rnams kyis mchod/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma bshams la/ 'dzam bu gling dang gling gzhan rnams// nor bu rin chen gyis bkang ste// stong gsum la sogs ma lus pa// zhum pa med par byas te 'bul// zhes brjod la maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ mtshan brjod 'don/ bstod pas bstod/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis bdag la shes rab phun sum tshogs pa bskyed du gsol/ zhes mos gus dang bcas pas gsol ba gdab/ de'i dus su mdun du 'jam dpal bskyed la/ rang nyid tha mal pa'i gzugs su bya'o// las kha tshar bstan pa la bzhi ste/ nyes byas 'joms pa'i 'khor lo/ yon tan sgrub pa'i 'khor lo/ gzhan dang rtsod pa bya thabs/ mā shā sran ma la brten pa'i las sbyor ro// dang po ni/ rang nyid 'jam dpal du bsgoms pa'i snying gi rtse mo gyen du bstan pa'i nang du 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs drug gi lte ba la a/ rtsibs drug la mdun phyogs nas brtsams te g.yas skor du/ oṃ wā kye daṃ na maḥ zhes pa bkod la/ 'khor lo g.yas la yig 'bru g.yon du 'khor bas sdig sgrib sangs sangs dag par bsams la/ bzlas pa bya'o/ 'khor lo shugs drag tu bskor bas ni snying rlung la sogs pa'i nyes pa mi 'byung*/ 'khor lo'i rtse mo rno bar bsgoms pas ni blo rno zhing stobs dang ldan par 'gyur ro// kha dog dkar po bsgoms pas 'dzin blo bzang bar 'gyur ro// gnyis pa yon tan sgrub pa'i 'khor lo ni/

rang gi lce'i steng du a dkar po zhig bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mdun du spyan drangs la/ 'od zer gnyis pa 'phros pas/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas shes rab kyi ngo bo a dkar po grangs med pa spyan drangs la/ rang gi lce steng gi a la thim pas/ lus thams cad a dkar pos mer gyis gang bar bsams la bzlas pa bya'o// de ltar byas pas mi brjed pa'i gzungs thob par 'gyur ro// gsum pa rtsod pa bya thabs ni/ rang gi lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong la ral gri sngo sangs yu ba la as mtshan zhing gri rtse la me 'bar ba gcig bsgom/ de'i a las 'od zer 'phros pas phyir rgol ba'i snying gar shes rab kyi ngo bo a dkar po la phog rdo khab len la lcags 'du ba bzhin tshur 'dus ral gri'i so la thim/ de nas rang gi snying gar thim pas kho'i shes rab rang gi grogs su gyur par bsgom/ yang gri rtse las me chad/ phyir rgol ba'i lce steng du phog pas lce thul gyis tshig par bsgom mo// de ltar byas na rang rtsod pa las mi rgyal mi srid do// paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrīs mu stegs pa btul ba bzhin no// bzhi pa sran ma'i las sbyor ni/ sran dkar mes ma tshig pa/ snum gyis ma reg pa/ dar dkar pos dril la rang 'jam dpal du bsgoms pa'i lce 'og tu bcug ste/ nyi ma'am zla ba gzas bzung nas ma grol gyi bar du bzlas pa byas na myu gu 'byung bar 'gyur ro// de nas sran ma de ba dmar mo'i 'o ma'am/ ra dkar mo'i 'o ma'am/ chu gtsang mas phul te/ sos ma reg par mid par bya'o// de ltar byas pas shes rab 'phel zhing lus skra dkar dang gnyer ma med cing tshe ring bar 'gyur ro// bdag sogs 'gro drug gti mug mun pa'i nags khrod gnas pa la// 'jam dbyangs nyi ma'i 'od kyis gsal mdzad de yi sgrub thabs ni// ma ti'i rjes 'brangs gsal byed 'di ni rgya ston bdag gis sbyar// nor 'khrul bzod mdzod dge bas 'gro kun 'jam dbyangs nyid gyur shog/

༈ /mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpa' bo gcig pu grub pa'i rgyud kyi 'jam dpal bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du btang nas/ swa bhā wa'i sngags brjod cing chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsams pa'i ngang las/ bam̐ yig dkar po zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho dkar zhing bsil ba/ glang po che dang*/ ngang ngur dang*/ chu bya mang po rol zhing rtse la skad snyan pa'i sgra sgrogs pa/ de'i dbus su pam̐ ljang ser las pad+ma'i sdong po yal ga lo 'bras dri bsung phun sum tshogs pa'i steng du/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsil zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba'i gdan la/ rang gi sems a dkar po 'od kyi drwa ba sna tshogs pa 'phro ba'i 'od zer gyis 'phags pa rnams mchod pa dang*/ sems can smin pa'i don byas/ slar 'dus a dkar po nyid la 'dus shing yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid 'jam pa'i dbyangs su gyur pa ni/ ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ lo brgyad lon pa'i byis pa gzhon nu'i gzugs can/ zur phud lnga dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas pa mchog sbyin pa'i phyag rgya can/ g.yon ut+pa la'i sdong bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ phrag gong g.yon gyi thad du legs par kha bye ba la shes rab kyi pustis mtshan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung bcas shing*/ brtan par bzhugs pa'i mtshan dpe'i 'od 'bar ba/ rin po che du ma'i rgyan dang dar dkar gyi na bza' spros pa'i gnas gsum du yi ge gsum/ thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i a yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs shing mchod la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ dbyer med du byas te lha sku la rtse gcig tu dmigs par bya'o// de'i ngang la thugs kar zla ba'i steng du 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs drug pa'i lte ba la a/ rtsibs drug la g.yas skor du/ oṃ wā kye daṃ na maḥ yig 'bru dkar po 'od zer dkar dmar 'phro ba 'khor lo la ma reg tsam du bkod la 'khor lo chos skor du myur du 'khor bas/

yig 'bru g.yon du 'khor ba lta bur snang ba la dmigs te bzlas pa bya'o// 'khor lo'i lte ba dang yig 'bru rnams mi 'gul ba yin no gsungs/ myur du 'khor bas khams 'dus pa la sogs pa'i skyon sel zhing blo gros myur ba dang*/ rtse mo rno bas shes rab rno zhing stobs che ba dang*/ dkar zhing 'od zer 'phro bas 'dzin blo gsal bar 'gyur ro// thun 'jog khar mchod bstod gsol ba gdab pa bsngo ba dang bcas pa byas la ye shes pa gshegs par bya'o// rdzun dang sha chang sgog btsong yang spang zhing*/ 'khon grib bud med la 'dzem pa dang*/ yi ge la mi 'gom zhing*/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba dang*/ mtshan brjod 'dod pa la brtson par bya'o// grangs kyi bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bya zhing*/ des ma grub na da drug 'gyur du bzlas pas ji skad bshad pa'i mtshan ma dang las rnams 'grub par 'gyur ro// de nas shes rab sgrub pa'i las sbyor ni/ nyi zla sgra gcan gyis 'dzin pa'i tshe/ sngon du rten dang mchod pa bshams nas bdag bskyed legs par bsgoms la/ grogs la brda sbyor du bcug ste/ rang gis mig mi blta bar bzung nas ma grol gyi bar du bal sran dkar po'am/ sran dkar ma gas ma rul mes ma reg pa gsum la sogs pa dar dri ma med pas dril te lce 'og tu bcug la bzlas pa bya zhing*/ myu gu byung na ra dkar mo'i 'o ma'am/ gur gum gyi chu dang bcas pa sran ma sos ma reg par mid par bya'o// myu gu ma byung na'ang phye mar byas te gdon gyis zin pa'i mgor btab na grol bar 'gyur ro// gri lcags la rgyal gyi nyin bar ral gri sor bcu gnyis pa byas te/ lag par bzung nas snga ma bzhin du bzlas na ral gri'i rig pa 'dzin pa dang*/ mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur ro// mig sman ni/ bcud len gyi ril bu rdza gsar par blugs te lag pa g.yon du bzhag nas/ g.yas pas bkab cing snga ma bzhin du bzlas na 'od dang du ba dang rlangs pa 'byung bar 'gyur te/

mig la byug pa dang khong du 'thungs pas lkog gyur mthong ba dang*/ rgas nad las grol ba dang*/ tshe'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro// lce'i rtsa bar a dkar po bsams la/ de'i 'od kyis 'phags pa dang*/ so so skye bo mkhas pa rnams kyi yon tan dang nor bu sman dang nags tshal gyi nus pa thams cad bsdus te/ ā li kā li'i rnam par gyur nas mgrin par thim pa la dmigs shing bzlas na blo gros phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro// rtsom na thugs kar dpal be'u bsams nas snga ma bzhin gyi dmigs pa bya'o// 'chad na mgrin par dung dkar gyi nang thams cad ā li kā lis gang ba las snga ma bzhin dmigs par bya'o// rtsod na lce ral grir bsams pa'i 'od kyis pha rol gyi blo nus tshur bsdus te/ phyir rgol gyi lce dum bur bcad cing ral gri'i me 'od kyis bsregs par bsams la rtsod pa bya'o// paṇa chen ma ti'i gzhung bzhin/ bsod snyoms pa rin chen rgyal mtshan

spos khang pa gyis yi ger bkod pa 'dis kyang sems can thams cad mkhyen rab phun sum tshogs par gyur cig/ ༈ /'jam dbyangs dkar po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so// na mo bhaṭ+ṭā ra ka mañdzu shrī bud+dha siṃ hā ya/ khrus dang gtsang sbra sngon du 'gro bas bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste/ ngag tu/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sogs kyis skyabs 'gro nyer gcig sogs bya'o// sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyud dang ldan par gyur cig sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ sems can thams cad kyi gti mug gi sgrib pa gsal nas shes rab kyi snang ba la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sgom bzlas nyams su blangs bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las rgya mtsho chen po dkar zhing dwangs pa/ mtha' ne'u gseng gis brgyan pa'i steng na glang po che sna tshogs gnas pa/ mtsho steng me tog sna tshogs bkra ba'i steng na bya skad snyan par sgrogs pas brgyan pa/ de'i dbus su pam̐ ljang ser las pad+ma'i sdong po yal ga dang lo ma gser las byas pa 'dab ma rgyas pa'i dbus su/ pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ge sar dmar ser yod pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rang gi sems nyid a dkar po zhig tu gyur/ de las dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi gti mug gi sgrib pa sbyangs/ shes rab kyi snang ba la bkod/ 'od zer tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun 'jam dpal sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/

g.yon pas ut+pa la'i yu ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ 'dab ma snyan gyi thad kar kha gyes pa'i steng na stong phrag brgya pa'i pusti 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can zur phud lnga dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ brgyad gnyis lon pa'i na tshod can/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi snying gi rtse mo gyen du bstan pa'i dbus su 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs drug pa'i lte ba la a/ rtsibs drug la mdun nas brtsams te/ oṃ wā kye daṃ na ma: zhes pa g.yas skor du bkod la/ yi ge rnams 'khor lo la ma reg pa'i tshul du gnas pa/ de nas 'khor lo g.yas su 'khor/ yig 'bru rnams g.yon du 'khor bas sdig sgrib rnams sangs sangs dag par bsams la/ oṃ wā kye daṃ na ma/ zhes pa 'bum tsho gsum bzla ba ni grangs kyi bsnyen pa sogs bya ba yin/ rjes kyi bya ba ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya mañdzu shrī ar+ghaṃ pa tīts+tsha swā hā sogs nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā'i bar gyis mchod/ shin tu dkar ba'i mdangs ldan mtsho yi dbus na pad+ma ge sar gyi// sdong por 'khrungs shing ri bong 'dzin pa'i steng na rje btsun 'jam dbyangs ni// gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs gangs ri dang mtshungs pa// zhal gcig phyag gnyis mchog sbyin ut+pal legs bsnams 'jam dbyangs khyod la 'dud// ces bstod nas/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab phun sum tshogs pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rje btsun 'jam dbyangs 'grub gyur nas// sogs kyis dge ba bsngo'o// las kha tshar ston pa rnams kyi yig cha rgya ston gyis mdzad pa las rtogs par bya'o// 'di'i rjes gnang ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la/ sbyor ba ni/

stegs ji ltar rigs pa'i steng du maṇ+ḍal la 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa bris pa'i dbus su a/ rtsibs rnams la mdun nas brtsams te oṃ wā kye daṃ na ma: zhes rdul tshon dkar pos bri/ dbus su 'jam dpal gyi sku dang mtshan brjod rnams bkod/ mthar phyogs mtshams brgyad du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang*/ shar mdun du gtor ma gcig dang*/ gzhan yang maṇ+ḍal me tog sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i lag len ltar bsham mo// dngos gzhi ni/ slob dpon gyis mchod pa rnams/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ sogs kyi byin rlabs sgrub thabs brgya rtsa ltar bya'o// bdag dang 'gro ba sogs nas stsal du gsol/ zhes pa'i bar gong ltar bya'o// mdun bskyed bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bam̐ las rgya mtsho/ sogs nas/ bzlas pa'i skabs 'dir/ bam̐ las rgya mtsho nas/ skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin la/ rang gi sems nyid dang*/ rang nyid ces pa'i tshig dor/ de nas/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar 'khor lo dkar po/ sogs nas/ yi ge rnams 'khor lo la ma reg pa'i tshul du gnas pa/ de nas 'khor lo g.yas dang*/ yig 'bru g.yon du 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad sangs sangs dag par bsams la bzlas pa sogs dkyus ltar ro// rjes la gsol gdab rnams bya/ mchod pa byin rlabs/ mchod bstod gong ltar bya'o// gtor ma bsang sbyang byin rlabs brgya rtsa ltar bya'am/ yang na/ a kā ro'i sngags lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/ phyag rgya dang bcas pas mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ mchod bstod gong ltar dang*/ gsol ba gdab bo// dbang bskur ba thob pa'i slob ma khrus byas/ me tog bkye bsdu sogs grub rjes/ slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/

sogs kyis sems bskyed gsal btab nas/ gsan par zhu/ bar spyi 'gre/ de la 'dir gsan rgyu'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gdul bya'i bsam pa dang mthun par chos kyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs te/ de la'ang rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa gnyis gsungs pa las/ 'dir sngags kyi theg pa yin/ de la'ang mchog dang thun mong sgrub pa'i thabs du ma zhig yod pa las 'dir phyi ma yin/ de la'ang zhi rgyas dbang drag dang rjes su 'grel ba'i yi dam gyi lha bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa'i nang nas rgyas pa yin/ rgyas pa la'ang tshe rgyas par byed pa dang*/ longs spyod rgyas par byed pa dang*/ blo gros rgyas par byed pa dang*/ mnga' ris rgyas par byed pa la sogs pa du ma zhig yod pa'i nang nas/ 'dir blo gros rgyas par byed pa la/ ma rig pa'i mun pa drungs nas phyung ste chos dang chos ma yin pa rnam par 'byed par byed pa la bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can zhig dgos pas/ de la rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa'i nang nas 'dir rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkar po'i rjes su gnang ba bsgrub pa la yid ches shing khungs btsun par bya ba'i ched du lo rgyus cung zad brjod na/ slob dpon dze tā ri dgra las rnam par rgyal ba des 'phags pa 'jam dpal las chos mngon sum du gsan cing grub pa brnyes pa yin/ lan cig 'phags pa 'jam dpal byon nas da lta khyod kyis mi lo brgyad cu lon/ da bcu las mi thub pas snod dang ldan pa'i bu gcig tshol la/ de la nga'i chos 'di ston la chig brgyud gyis zhes lung bstan/ de nas dze tā ri dgra las rnam par rgyal bas rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la 'phur te phyogs kun tu gzigs nas snod ldan gyi bu btsal bas ma rnyed/ slar ma ga dhā'i yul du gzigs pas/

ma he'i rdzi bo rgas shing 'khogs pa 'tsho ba dang bral ba zhig 'dug pa de snod ldan du gzigs nas der byon te/ khyod snod dang ldan par 'dug pas las 'di zhol la chos sgor zhugs shig gsungs pas/ de na re/ bdag rgas shing 'khogs la 'tsho ba'ang med/ yi ge'ang mi shes pas tshe phyi ma la rjes su bzung bar zhu zer/ der slob dpon gyis thabs yod gsungs nas sgrub thabs 'di byin nas bsgrubs pas zhag bdun nas chos thams cad rang grol du shes pa'i paṇ+ḍi tar gyur nas paṇ+ḍi ta ma ti zhes bya bar grags so// de nas slob dpon gyis 'jam dpal zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur te gsang mtshan sgeg pa'i rdo rje zhes bya bar btags so// de nas shrī na len+d+rar rab tu byung ste mngon par byang chub pa'i skal ba can zhes bya bar btags so// nor bu'i gling du sku 'khrungs pas nor bu gling pa bde ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba grags so// de nas slob dpon la phyag byas nas/ slob dpon gyi thugs rjes bzung bas mkhas par gyur kyang*/ da rgas pas bshad pa byed mi nus sgrub pa zhig byed par zhu zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas khyod rang la tshe'i lhag ma lo bcu yod pa dang*/ nga la yi dam gyis lung bstan pa'i lo bcu yod pa las lo gnyis song*/ da lo brgyad yod pas khyod la sbyin gyis lo bco brgyad bar du 'gro don gyis/ de nas yi dam la gsol ba thob dang*/ tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa 'ong srid gsungs nas slob dpon mkha' spyod du gshegs so// de nas sgeg pa'i rdo rjes nor bu gling pa chung ba la gsungs/ des 'byung gnas sbas pa la/ des paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya shrī la gnang ba yin/ khong bod du khro phu lo tsā bas gdan drangs/ dbus kyi srin po rir dbyar gnas mdzad pa'i dus su/ bod rnams kyis rgya gar ba'i shes rab ma do nas/ khro phu lo tsā bas/ bla ma la shes rab 'phel ba'i gdams pa zhus pas/

paṇ+ḍi ta'i zhal nas nga la gdams pa rgya mtsho tsam mnga' ba'i nang nas gdams pa khyad par can bzhi yod/ bde mchog dkar po la brten nas byang chub sgrub pa dang*/ 'jam dpal dkar po la brten nas blo 'phel ba dang*/ yang dag me gcig thod gcig la brten nas ras thub pa dang*/ dzam bha la nag po la brten nas nor sgrub pa dang bzhi las/ 'di 'jam dpal dkar po la brten nas blo 'phel ba yin gsungs nas thams cad la gnang ba yin/ bde mchog dang dzam bha la'i bka' rjes gnang zhus pas/ khyed rang rnams bal yul du 'gro na ngas bya yi gsungs/ der khro phu lo tsā bas bal yul du skyel thung byas nas zhus pas/ da mi khom gsungs nas ma gnang*/ yang yang gsol ba btab pas khyod de tsam du gdung sems yod na da sbyin gyi gsungs nas/ paṇ+ḍi tas dbu snyung bzhes pa'i gdams ngag yin gsungs nas gnang ba yin/ de nas rim pa ltar brgyud pa'i 'jam dpal dkar po'i rjes su gnang ba bsgrub pa la/ slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa thams cad legs par grub zin nas/ khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma'i bya ba la rjes gnang gi sngon du 'gro ba maṇ+ḍal dbul zhing gsol ba gdab pa/ rgyud dag par bya ba rnams su yod pa las/ thog mar rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang sogs/ zhes gsol ba btab nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkar po la gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sogs spyi dang 'dra bar bsams nas/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs kyis rgyud dag par bya ba ni rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i a yig las 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab par 'phros/

khyed rang gi lus la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang*/ khyad par mi shes pa'i mun pa rnam smin gdos bcas sha khrag gi phung po khams dang skye mched la sogs pa bsregs shing sbyangs te lus 'od kyi gong bu re rer gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nyid la dmigs te/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs nas/ skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i sku can du gsal bar dmigs nas/ de la brten nas sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi rjes su gnang ba la/ thog mar sku'i rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gang tshe lta bar 'dod pa'am// cung zad 'dri bar 'dod na yang*// mgon po 'jam dbyangs de nyid ni// gegs med par yang mthong bar shog /ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon gyis 'jam dpal gyi sku khyed rang gi spyi bor bzhag ste sku'i rjes su gnang ba byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku che ba// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung yang yin// sangs rgyas kun gyis byin brlabs pas// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku thob shog /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas 'jam dpal gyi sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon nas khyed rang gi spyi gtsug nas thim pas/ khyed rang gi lus dang 'jam dpal gyi sku gnyis su med par gyur pa mos pa mdzod/ de ltar na sku'i rjes su gnang ba thob pas de la phan yon gnyis te/ gnas skabs su lus la nad med pa dang*/ mthong ba tsam gyis 'gro ba dad pa dang*/ mthar thug mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa'i 'jam dpal gyi sku thob par 'gyur ba yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ gsung gi rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ brtse ldan khyod kyi mkhyen rab 'od zer gyis// bdag blo'i gti mug mun pa rab bsal te/ bka' dang bstan bcos gzhung lugs rtogs pa yi// blo gros spobs pa'i snang ba bskyed du gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/

dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku can du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i snying gi rtse mo gyen du bstan pa'i dbus su 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs drug gi lte ba la a/ rtsibs drug la mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du/ oṃ wā kye daṃ na maḥ zhes pa'i sngags kyi yig 'bru rnams 'khor lo la ma reg pa'i tshul du gnas pa'i 'khor lo g.yas dang yig 'bru g.yon du 'khor bar gsal btab/ khyed rang rnams kyang 'jam dpal gyi sku can du gsal ba'i snying gi rtse mo gyen du bstan pa'i dbus su 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs drug gi lte ba la a/ rtsibs drug la mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du/ oṃ wā kye daṃ na maḥ zhes pa'i sngags kyi yig 'bru 'khor lo la ma reg pa'i tshul gyis mtshan par gsal btab nas/ slob dpon la rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos yin snyam pa'i gus 'dud byas pa'i rkyen gyis/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'khor lo sngags phreng dang bcas pa las de 'dra ba byung ste zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i 'khor lo la 'khor lo dang*/ sngags phreng la sngags phreng thim pas 'khor lo g.yas dang*/ yig 'bru g.yon du 'khor bas sdig sgrib rnams sangs sangs dag bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can rgyud la skyes par mos pa byas nas/ me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ wā kye daṃ na maḥ zhes lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byis gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pa man chad kyis brtan par mos nas/ slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul du me tog gtor te/ gsol ba 'debs pa'i yid kyis 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis sogs spyi dang 'dra/ de ltar na gsung gi rjes gnang thob pas de la phan yon gnyis te/ gnas skabs su 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mkhas pa dang*/

mthar thug gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu thob par 'gyur ba yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i rjes gnang gi slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ shes pas srid la mi gnas shing*// snying rjes zhi la mi gnas pas// mya ngan 'das dang 'khor mi gnas// 'jam dpal thugs la gsol ba 'debs// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams lus bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan par bya ba ni/ rkang pa skyil krung*/ lag pa mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya/ sgal tshigs drang por bsrangs/ mig bar snang du gtad de mdun gyi nam mkhar yi ge a dkar po zhig gsal bar dmigs te de nyid la sems gtad nas/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ a a sogs nyer gcig brjod pa'i mthar a de yang me long la has btab pa bzhin mtha' nas rim bzhin bsdus nas nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar yal te dmigs pa ci yang yid la mi byed pa nam mkha' lta bu ste/ nam mkha' la thog mtha' med pa ltar sems la thog mtha' med/ nam mkha' la 'gro 'ong med pa ltar sems la 'gro 'ong med/ nam mkha' la 'dus byas kyi gnod pas mi brdzi ba ltar sems la glo bur gyi rkyen gyis mi brdzi/ nam mkhas phyi nang gi chos thams cad la khyab pa ltar sems kyis 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la khyab ste/ spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la cung zad cig mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ de nyid brtan pa'i phyir du slob dpon gyis me tog spyi bor bzhag ste brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod do// de ltar na thugs kyi rjes gnang thob pas de la phan yon gnyis te/ gnas skabs su chos la blo 'gro zhing*/ mthar thug shes bya ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin thob par 'gyur ba yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ yon tan phrin las kyi rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/

dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// phyi ma byang chub ma thob bar// bcom ldan 'jam dbyangs mgon gyis ni// bdag gi bla mar mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ khyed rang gi phyag tu mtshan brjod gtad de/ yon tan dang phrin las kyi rjes su gnang ba byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ 'di na 'jam dpal gyi rgyud bzhugs/ khyed rang yang nyams su longs/ sems can rnams la'ang phan thogs par gyis shig ces pas sbyin no// de ltar na yon tan phrin las kyi rjes gnang thob pas de la phan yon gnyis te/ gnas skabs su rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas shing sems can gyi don sgrub pa dang*/ mthar thug 'jam dpal la mnga' ba'i yon tan phrin las dang mnyam par 'gyur ba yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de nas dge ba bsngo ba ni/ 'di ltar bsgrub pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gang thob pa des bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ 'di bsgrub pa las byung ba yi// dge ba bdag gis gang thob pa// de yis skye bo thams cad kyis// bde gshegs shes rab thob par shog /ces bsngo ba dang bcas pa rnams kyis dngos gzhi grub nas/ de dag gi gnas skabs su sogs nas/ gtso bos dang*/ maṇ+ḍal dang*/ deng nas sogs spyi dang 'dra'o// rjes ni mchod pa byin rlabs dang mchod bstod 'dod don gsol btab rnams gong ltar bya/ sku la brtan bzhugs rab gnas bya/ rang gi gnas gsum bsrung*/ bkra shis dang bsngo ba sogs bya'o// zhes pa 'di ni rang gi dran pa gso ba'i phyir du mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs bud+dha siṃ ha'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa brang btsun nam mkha'i ming can gyis re zhig tu e waṃ thar rtse'i gzim khang du sug bris su byas pa'o// 'di'i rgyab rten du yi ge rnying pa la blta bar bya ba 'bad par rigs so// shu bhaṃ maṅga laṃ bha wan+tu//

༈ /'jam dpal dkar po ma ti lugs kyi bsnyen pa bya tshul lag len rnam gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs// shes bya kun gzigs chos kyi rgyal po'i gnas// mngon gyur bar du mtha' klas shes bya'i gnas// snang byed bla ma 'jam dbyangs tha mi dad// lhag pa'i lha ru bsnyen tshul yi ger 'god// de'ang gang zag dbang thob cing khyad par 'di'i rjes gnang dang man ngag legs par mnos pas rang gzhan gyi ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal ba'i phyir slob dpon ma ti nas brgyud pa'i 'jam dpal dkar po'i bsnyen pa bya ba'i tshul la/ dang por mtshams la 'jug pa'i dus gza' skar 'phrod sbyor sogs bzang bar sngon byung ston pa'i bdud btul ba'i dus dang bstun na srod kyi dang po mun rub bam/ yang na shes rab rgyas pa'i rten 'brel gyis snga dro nyi ma shar 'phral nas 'jug ste/ de'i sbyor ba ni gtor ma sha chang gi dri ma med par zlum gtor theb kyu bzhis bskor ba rgyan ldan bsham/ de'i mdun du nyer spyod rnams sbreng tshar bsham/ 'jam dkar gyi sku bris 'bur gang rigs de'i thad kyi gyang logs su dgram/ rang nyid kha shar ram lho ru phyogs par bsdad/ gnas khang gis stabs ma bde na kha shar bltas su yod par bsam pas chog rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu bkra shis kyi me tog snod bcas dang*/ chab len pa'i bum pa'ang 'du bya/ de nyin gyi sngon 'gro la cha gsum gtor ma bshams nas gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar cha gsum cho gas btang nas/ mtshams bcad de sgo rtsar tho 'dzugs bya/ de nas brtsams te mtshams 'og 'jug dgos bzhi lnga tsam lta bu dgos nges min pa mang po mi 'jug de nas mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bha wa sogs kyis sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las sogs nas shab+da swā hā zhes dang*/ dharma ra ṇi lan gsum brjod pa'i bar spyi ltar bya/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul bla ma dang 'jam dpal gnyis su med pa'i dkon mchog gsum gyi tshogs rnams gsal btab pa'i spyan sngar bdag gzhan sems can thams cad 'khod de skyabs 'gro byed par bsams nas/

mar gyur nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma sogs skyabs 'gro dang por zhag gnyis gsum tsam la skyabs su 'gro ba thun re la'ang ci tsam nus pa blo dang 'dres nges par bya/ de nas/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gcig brjod pas skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu nas rang gzhan sems can thams cad la thim pas byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs par bsam/ de nas tshad med bzhi spyi ltar bsgom/ sems can thams cad kyi gti mug gi sgrib pa bsal sogs sems bskyed la lan gsum brjod/ dngos gzhi swa bhā wa sogs nas/ yig 'bru rnams g.yon du 'khor bas sdig sgrib rnams sangs sangs dag par bsam// zhes pa'i bar 'don bsgom bya/ de nas thugs ka'i 'khor lo 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa'i dmigs pa de nyid dang bcas te sngags bzla ba'i sgang la ngag bcad dam par bya/ gsol ja bzhes 'phral chab len pa sogs gtsang sbra bya/ thun bsdu ba na bdag nyid la mchod par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs kyis mchod/ shin tu dkar ba'i sogs nas shes rab phun sum tshogs pa stsal du gsol/ zhes bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i rjes su/ snga thun dgongs thun gang rung zhig gi mthar gtor ma 'bul te/ de'ang gtor ma chu gtsang gis bran la/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ gtor mgron bskyed pa ni/ bris sku sogs kyi rten swa bhā wa sogs kyis stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bam̐ las rgya mtsho chen po dkar zhing sogs/

rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar rang nyid ces pa dor ba ma gtogs bdag bskyed ltar brjod/ de'i thugs kar shes rab kyi 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa'i lte bar a/ rtsibs drug la mdun nas brtsams te oṃ wā kye daṃ na maḥzhes pas bskor ba/ de'i thugs ka'i a yig las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas de la gnyis su med par bstims nas/ de la oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya mañdzu shrī i daṃ ba l+yā di kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa lan gsum mam lnga sogs kyis phul/ oṃ sarba ta thā sogs nas ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ shin tu dkar ba'i mdangs ldan sogs kyis bstod cing gsol 'debs sngar bzhin bya/

spro na mtshan yang dag par brjod pas kyang bstod/ de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu sku gzugs kyi rten 'di la bskyed cing bstims pa'i lha tshogs thams cad ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hās me tog gtor/ de nas/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rje btsun 'jam dbyangs 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces dge ba bsngo zhing*/ bdag gis dus 'di nas bzung ste zhes sh+lau ka gcig gis smon lam btab la/ bkra shis gang rigs brjod/ thun mtshams thams cad du bdag nyid 'jam dpal gyi nga rgyal dang ma bral bar bya'o// des thun gcig song*/ thun gnyis pa la skyabs 'gro nas bzung ste bzlas pa'i mjug gi mchod bstod gsol ba btab rjes su/ gtor bsngo dor nas/ dge ba bsngo ba la 'jug go /thun gsum pa la'ang de dang 'dra ste de ltar thun gsum byed pa'i lugs yin/ gal te thun bzhi byung na shin tu legs te/ tho rangs nas nyi dros bar thun dang po/ de rjes nas nyin phyed bar thun gnyis pa/ phyed yol nas dgongs mo'i bar thun gsum pa/ de nas srod thun bar thun bzhi pa byed pa yin no// de lta bu'i sgo nas grangs bsnyen 'bum phrag drug bya bar bshad kyang thog ma'i bsnyen pa zla ba gcig la sngags 'bum phrag bcu sogs gang 'gro dang gsang sngags nus pa 'byin byed sbyin sreg dang bcas pa grub na legs pa yin no// 'di'i sgrub skor ma tis mdzad pa'i rgya gzhung dang bod gzhung rgya ston dang chag lo tsā dang mkhan chen bud+dha lak+ṣ+mis mdzad pa'i sgrub yig sogs mang du snang ngo*// lha mchog 'jam dpal ji ltar bsnyen pa'i thabs// rnam gsal bgyis pa'i bsod nams sems can khams// blo gros me long dwangs par gtsug lag gzugs// brgya phrag 'gogs med 'char ba'i rgyur bsngo'o// zhes 'jam dpal dkar po ma ti'i lugs kyi bsnyen pa bya tshul lag len rnam gsal zhes bya ba 'di'ang ldan yul shod kyi sa 'dzin mgon po rnam rgyal ba'i gsung gis bskul 'phral ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ//

༈ /'jam dpal dkar po ma ti'i lugs kyi rjes gnang gi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs// rje btsun 'jam dbyangs paṇa chen ma ti'i zhabs// mkhas mchog shākya shrī dang byang chub dpal// bde ba dpal dang sangs rgyas gzhon nu can// bsod nams shes rab mkhan chen shes rab mgon// shar chen ye rgyal ngor chen kun dga' bzang*// rgyal tshab kun dbang rat+na war+bha dang*// dkon mchog lhun grub nam mkha' dpal bzang po// nam mkha' sangs rgyas nam mkha' dpal bzang dang*// sangs rgyas phun tshogs tshul khrims lhun grub sogs// byin rlabs gdams ngag dngos brgyud bla ma dang*// 'jam dpal la sogs yi dam rgyal ba sras// bstan srung bcas la phyag 'tshal bsnyen pa'i mthus// bdag gzhan las nyon sgrib pa kun sbyangs nas// gzhung lugs kun shes 'chad rtsom rtsod pa la// thogs pa med pa'i blo gros 'od brgya pa'i// phan bde'i snang bas bstan 'gror khyab par mdzod// ces pa 'jam dpal dkar po'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'di ni ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /'jam dpal dkar po'i brgyud 'debs kyi kha skong ni/ nam mkha' sangs rgyas nam mkha' dpal bzang dang*// zhes pa'i mtshams/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs bsod nams dpal ldan zhabs// bstan 'dzin lhun grub dpal ldan chos skyong dang*// rin chen mchog grub nam mkha' 'chi med zhabs// skyabs gnas kun 'dus kun dga' bstan 'dzin sogs// byin brlabs gdams ngag dngos brgyud bla ma dang*// sogs sbrel lo// zhes pa'ang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos so// ༈ /'jam dpal dkar po ma ti lugs kyi bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i zin bris bdud rtsi'i snang ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ gang du 'char bas rmongs pa'i mun bsal nas// blo mchog pad+mo'i rdzing bu dar mdzad pa'i// 'jam mgon smra ba'i nyi ma'i ye shes kyis// byang chub snying po'i bar du skyong gyur cig

/de yi gsang gsum bsnyen cing sgrub pa dang*// phrin las zla ba nor bu'i snyems 'chang bas// skal bzang yid la bdud rtsi'i snang ster ba// phan bde'i chu gter rgyas pa'i dpyid du sbyin// e ma 'chi med zil dngar dang*// dpag bsam rkang pas 'thung ba yis// mtshon min legs par bshad pa'i rgyun// 'jig rten gsum gyi gdung sel nyid// de la 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi ye shes kyi skus mngon sum du rjes su bzung ba mkhas shing dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen po dze tā ri dgra las rnam par rgyal ba'i byin rlabs kyi bdud rtsis spobs pa'i gter mdzod chen po brgyad kyi ut+pa la kha yongs su bye ba ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta ma ti'am/ grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba bi lā sa badz+ra nas nye bar brgyud pa'i 'jam dpal dkar po'i gdams pa zab mo 'di 'chad pa la gnyis te/ yid ches shing khungs btsun par bya ba'i slad du lo rgyus dang*/ lo rgyus de ldan gyi gdams pa dngos so// dang po la'ang bshad bya chos kyi lo rgyus dang*/ bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus gnyis las/ dang po ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis/ rang nyid kyis ji ltar gzigs pa'i don de nyid gzhan la 'doms pa'i slad/ gdul bya'i skal ba dang 'tshams pa'i thabs la mkhas pas chos kyi bdud rtsi bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la rgyud sde bzhir bzhugs pa las/ 'dir rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams kyi bzhed pas/ bya ba dang*/ spyod pa dang*/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud rnams la ma brten kyang 'grub pa'i gsang sngags rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang mthun par gsungs par bzhed cing*/ gtso bor ye shes pa gzhug pa ma bstan pa'i phyir spyod rgyud de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su gtogs shing*/ lha'i ngo bo tsam gyi sgo nas bya rgyud de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi 'khor los sgyur par bzhag kyang mi 'gal ba 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig pu grub pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po la brten nas paṇ+ḍi ta ma tis legs par bkral ba'i sgrub thabs dang*/

bstod pa sogs kyi rjes su 'brangs te/ gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī bha dra'i phyag len ji lta ba bzhin khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis zin bris su btab pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge/ lo rgyus kyi yi ge rnying pa/ rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus dang*/ bsod snyoms pa rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa/ chag lo gsum pa rin chen chos rgyal gyis gtso bor ma ti'i rjes su 'brangs shing*/ man ngag gzhan rgyud 'grel pa dang bcas pa nas kyang kha bskangs pa'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi yi ge rgyas pa/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i 'jam dpal dkar po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang*/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'i bsnyen sgrub/ las sbyor/ sbyin sreg dang bcas pa sogs rang gzhan gyi mkhas shing dngos grub brnyes pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i yig cha ji snyed cig mthong zhing phal cher thos so// gnyis pa bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus ni/ zur bka' paṇ+ḍi ta ma ti nas brgyud pa'i tshul ni lo rgyus kyi yi ge rnying pa las shes la/ gzhan yang spyi bka' rtsod pa'i dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa yab sras nas bla ma ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags pa las brgyud de rje btsun sa skya pa chen po la bka' babs pa'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mas sngags rig smra ba rnams kyi mchog tu dbang bskur bas gzhung sh+lo ka 'bum phrag brtsams par grags pa'i grub chen a bha yā ka na gup+ta nas brgyud pa'i sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i gras su bzhugs pa dang*/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi ye shes sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rol gar gangs can gyi mgon po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na nas brgyud pa sogs kyi lo rgyus kyang so so'i skabs su shes par bya'o// gnyis pa gdams pa dngos la gsum ste/

dang po lha nye bar bsnyen pa'i cho ga bar du dngos grub sgrub pa'i tshul/ mthar las sbyor gyis rang gzhan rnams 'dod pa'i don la 'god pa'i cho ga dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi sgo nas lag tu blang ba'i tshul paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gi sgrub thabs dang zhu chen paṇ+ḍi ta'i bsnyen yig sogs las rtogs par bya zhing*/ 'dir de dag tu mi gsal ba mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyi gsung rab ltar cung zad bshad na/ gang gis nyams su len pa'i rten gyi gang zag des ji ltar nyams su blangs pa'i tshul/ de ltar nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ mtha' med pa'i 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las thar bar 'dod pa'i nges 'byung bcos min gyi brgyud sbyangs te/ dge bsnyen yan chad so sor thar pa'i sdom pa gang rung dang ldan pa/ sems can thams cad ma drin can kho nar shes shing*/ de rnams gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba la 'god pa'i slad du rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub pa'i lam gyi gtso bo rnams la tshul bzhin du slob 'dod kyis byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa thob la ma nyams pa/ de lta bu'i byang chub kyang dus myur du thob 'dod kyis gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba mtshan nyid dang ldan pa thob cing*/ dam tshig dang sdom pa'i kun spyod la tshul bzhin du slob pa gzhir bzhag ste/ bye brag tu 'di nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba dang man ngag gi rgyun thob pa/ bla ma la gus shing sgrub la brtson pa/ khrus dang gtsang sbra la gtso bor gnas pa'i gang zag gis nyams su blangs na myur du 'grub par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa ji ltar nyams su blang ba'i tshul ni/ yar ngo'i gza' skar tshes grangs bzang ba'i dus/ dben zhing nyams dga' la rang dbang 'dus pa'i gnas su sbyor ba'i chos rnams bsnyen yig ltar grub nas/ dngos gzhi'i thog mar dal 'byor gyi lus rten 'di lta bu rnyed dka' zhing 'jig sla ba dang*/

shi nas cang med du mi 'gro bar las rgyu 'bras kho na'i rjes su 'brangs te 'khor ba'i gnas rigs mtho dman gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gsum gyi rang bzhin kho na las ma 'das pas/ da res rang gzhan thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las ci nas kyang thar ba zhig bya/ de'i ched du bla ma dang dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro snyam pa'i 'dun pas/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma'i sku bstod ci shes byas rjes skyabs yul gsal gdab pa ni/ rang gnas pa'i sa phyogs thams cad bde ba can gyi zhing gi bkod pa lta bu phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i dbus su dpag bsam gyi sdong po/ yal ga dang*/ lo ma dang*/ me tog dang*/ 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa/ dran pa tsam gyis 'dod dgu yid bzhin du 'jo ba/ yal ga lnga pa'i dbus su pad zla'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma dang rje btsun 'jam dpal dkar po dbyer med pa la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyang 'jam dpal gyi rnam pas g.yas skor gyis zhal nang du phyogs pas bzhugs pa/ mdun du yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ g.yas su sangs rgyas longs sprul rnams/ rgyab tu theg pa che chung gi chos puste brag ri brtsegs pa lta bu/ g.yon du mkha' 'gro chos srung nor lha rnams bzhugs pa/ de rnams kyi mdun du rang gzhan sems can thams cad 'khod de/ byang chub ma thob kyi bar du/ ci mdzad khyed mkhyen snyam pa'i re ltos ling bskyur gyi 'dun pa phyogs gcig pas skyabs su 'gro bar bsams la/ skyabs 'gro ci nus su bya/ skyabs gsol byas pas skyabs yul rnams rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ de nyid rang gzhan sems can thams cad la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams la sems spros bral gyi ngang du bzhag rjes/ spros bral gyi gnas lugs de lta bu ma rtogs par rang dbang med par 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god par bya dgos/

de'ang sems can rnams 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i rtsa ba ni gti mug dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i gang zag gi bdag tu 'dzin pa kho na las byung ste/ dpal chos kyi grags pas rnam 'grel las/ bdag yod na ni gzhan du shes// bdag gzhan cha las 'dzin dang sdang*// 'di dag dang ni yongs 'brel las// nyes pa thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur// ces gsungs shing*/ de'i dngos kyi gnyen po gyur pa ni/ snga ma las/ byams sogs rmongs dang 'gal med phyir// nyes pa shin tu tshar gcod min// zhes dang*/ stong nyid lta dang de 'gal phyir// de yi rang bzhin nyes kun dang*// 'gal bar rab tu grub pa yin// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kho na la rags las shing*/ de'ang rgyu med rkyen med las mi 'byung bas/ da lan rgyu rkyen gyi gtso bo 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi ting nge 'dzin dang*/ gzungs kyi sgo bsgrub par bgyi'o snyam du sems bskyed la/ sems can thams cad sogs brjod/ tshad med bzhi bsgoms pas bsod nams kyi tshogs dang*/ swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis chos thams cad spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'i rang bzhin du shes pas ye shes kyi tshogs bsags te/ tshogs gnyis kyi rang 'bras sku dang ye shes zung du 'jug pa'i ngo bo rang nyid rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs su gsal btab cing*/ thugs kar shes rab kyi 'khor lo bkod pa rnams gzhung nas 'byung ba bzhin bya/ bzlas pa'i sngon du/ nor bu rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang gi gzungs las byung ba'i phreng sngags/ oṃ ru tsi ra ma ṇi pra bar+dha nā ya swā hā/ mchog tu mdzes pa'i nor bus rab tu 'phel ba'i gzhi tshugs/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis btab pa'i las mthun gyi phreng ba'am/ las thams cad la bsngags pa bo dhi tsi'i phreng ba bzung la/ oṃ wā kye daṃ na maḥ zhes yi ge drug pa'i sngags dag cing gsal ba gong bas tshor tsam du bzla/ de'i tshe spyir sems gzhan du ma yengs par dmigs pa la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag

dmigs pa gcig kho nas skyo na/ res lha sku'i cha shas spyi dang bye brag la sems bzung*/ res sngags kyi sgra la yid gtad/ res thugs ka'i 'khor lo la sems 'dzin/ res sems kyi gnas lugs brjod bral gyi ngang du ngal gso/ mdor na tha mal gyi rnam par rtog pa'i gzhan dbang du ma song bar bya/ 'di'i sgrub thabs tshig tshogs nyung bas nges par thun bzhir bya zhing*/ thun gyi mjug tu ji ltar bya ba'i tshul dang*/ thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul tshul rnams bsnyen yig las shes/ thun skabs rnams su paṇ+ḍi ta ma tis/ pha rol phyin dang bstod pa mang po dang*// mtshan nas brjod dang bstod pa mang pos bstod// maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba btab par bya// 'dis ni myur du 'grub par 'gyur ba yin// zhes gsungs pa'i don nyams su len pa ni/ bris sku'i mdun du maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma bsham/ rang gi mdun du rin po che'i snod me tog dkar po sil mas bkang ba bzhag ste/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma spyi ltar gyi/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid/ zhes pa'i mtshams/ bla ma rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi ma rig pa'i mun pa thams cad byang zhing dag pa dang*/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes sogs 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab cing me tog 'thor/ bris sku la lha dngos kyi 'du shes bya/ spro na maṇ+ḍal so bdun ma gang gi mchod rdzas ma dang bcas pa'ang bya/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa dang*/ gzhan yang paṇ+ḍi ta ma tis mdzad pa'i bstod pa dang*/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mīs mdzad pa'i bstod pa sogs kyis bstod cing gsol ba gdab/ chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid spros bral shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa don dam pa'i 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la nges shes bskyed de/

sdud pa tshigs su bcad pa sogs klog dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo zhing smon lam gyi rgyas gdab/ de lta bu'i rim pas grangs dang*/ rtags dang*/ dus kyi bsnyen pa mthar phyin par bya ste/ de yang grangs ni rgyud las/ sngon du bsnyen pa'i cho gas yi ge 'bum bzlas na sngags kyi rgyal po 'grub par 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta ma tis/ zla ba gcig gis blo 'phel rig pa 'dzin// zhes gsungs pa'i don/ zla ba gcig tu thun bzhi'i rim pas thun rer bzlas pa stong phrag lnga re bzlas pas/ 'bru 'bum ste 'bum phrag drug 'gro zhing dngos grub kyi mtshan ma'ang thob par 'gyur ro// rtags ni 'og nas 'byung ba ltar dngos nyams rmi lam du mthong ba'i bar dang*/ dus ni/ snyigs ma'i dbang gis grangs bsnyen lan gcig tsam gyis rtags ma byung na/ sngon gyi bsnyen pa zla ba gcig dang bcas pa'i sgrub pa lan drug tu bskyar te/ zla ba drug tu bsgom bzlas byas pas/ bsnyen pa 'bum phrag sum cu rtsa drug song ba na nges par 'grub par 'gyur te/ rgyud las/ zla ba drug gi man ngag gis ngag gi dbang phyug 'grub par byed do// zhes gsungs pa bzhin no// gsum pa 'bras bu la gnas skabs dang*/ mthar thug gnyis las/ dang po ni/ de ltar grangs dang*/ dus kyi bsnyen pa mthar phyin pas/ rab dngos su bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal mjal ba dang*/ gsung thos pa dang*/ 'bring nyams kyi snang bar rjes su bzung ba/ tha ma'ang rmi lam du bcom ldan 'das kyi sku mthong ba dang*/ gzhon nu gos dkar can gyis puste/ mtshon cha/ shel phreng*/ 'o thug sogs ster ba/ nyi zla shar ba/ sgron me sbar ba/ me tog rgyas pa'i dga' tshal du phyin pa sogs dge zhing shis pa'i mtshan ma 'byung ba dang*/ dngos su 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang*/ gzhung 'dzin pa sogs la sngar las blo gros kyi 'jug pa gsal bar 'gyur ro// gnyis pa ni/ de ltar mtshan ma rnyed nas kyang 'og tu bshad pa'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i tshul dang*/

khyad par dus kun tu bla ma dang 'jam dpal dbyer med pa bsnyen cing gsol ba shugs drag tu btab pas/ yi dam gyi lhas yang yang byin gyis brlabs pas rig pa 'dzin pa'i lus thob cing*/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can gyis 'phags pa'i ye shes khong du chud pas sa bcu dang lam lnga sogs rim gyis rdzogs nas bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal rdo rje'i ngo bor mngon par byang chub pa'i go 'phang brnyes te/ sku dang*/ ye shes dang*/ phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa la dbang 'byor pa ni nges pa'o// gnyis pa bar du dngos grub sgrub pa'i cho ga la'ang*/ sbyor/ dngos/ rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba ni/ ji skad bshad pa'i bsnyen pa sngon du song nas thog mar bris sku 'bri bar bya ste/ gnas dben zhing yid dang mthun pa gtsang sbra dang ldan par mtshams bsdams te/ lha bzo ba gso sbyong dang ldan pas 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi las kyi cho ga'i le'u las ras bris bdun bshad pa'i bdun pa 'di nyid 'bri bar bya ste/ rgyal phur 'dzom pa sogs gza' skar sbyor byed bzang po la/ ras dkar po skra med pa kha tshar ma nyams pa la spyin sogs mi gtsang ba ma 'dres par/ zar khu la sogs pas ras 'dul legs par byas la/ tshon ma 'dres par mtha' thams cad rtsi shing rgyas pa'i ri bos bskor ba sogs zhing gi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus su/ 'og tu bdud rtsi 'o ma'i rgya mtsho la me tog sna tshogs pa dag gis khyab par/ ngang ngur la sogs pa'i chu byas brgyan pa'i 'gram du ne'u gseng la glang po che thal dkar gyi tshogs gnas pa/ mtsho'i dbus na pad+ma'i sdong po yal ga lo ma gser las byas pa'i rtse mor pad+ma dkar po ches yangs pa'i lte ba ljang ser mtho ba'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la 'phags pa 'jam dpal ston zla ltar dkar ba/ g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon thugs kar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgyas ut+pala'i sdong bu 'dzin pa'i me tog snyan gyi thad sor kha bye ba'i steng du pusti bzhag pa 'dzin pa/

ral pa'i thor tshugs zur phud lnga dang ldan pa/ gzhon nu lang tsho rgyas pa/ dar dmar po'i sham shabs can/ bla gos phrag par gzar ba/ skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ pad sdong gi yal ga las thon pa'i g.yas g.yon du pad+ma dkar po zla ba dang bcas pa gnyis kyi steng du g.yas su kun tu bzang po pri yang ku ltar sngo bsangs/ g.yas rnga yab dkar po nor bu'i yu ba can g.yob cing*/ g.yon rin po che bsnams pa/ g.yon du spyan ras gzigs dkar po g.yas rnga yab gser gyi yu ba can dang*/ g.yon pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa/ gnyis ka zhi ba 'jam dpal la blta ba/ 'jam dpal las chung ba/ na bza' sngon po gsol ba/ rin po che'i cod can dang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mu tig dang rin po che'i mchod phyir thogs byas pa/ steng du lha'i bu gnyis kyis phreng ba 'dzin pa/ sprin sbubs las byung ba/ 'og tu rdo leb la sgrub pa po dbyibs cha lugs ji lta ba spos phor thogs pa/ gtso bo'i phyag mchog sbyin gyi 'og tu 'khod nas bcom ldan 'das la lta bar bri/ bris zin ma thag ras bris shar du dgram/ mchod pa rgya chen po bsham/ lhar bskyed mchod bstod spyan dbye bya/ brtan bzhugs kyi me tog 'thor zhing shis pa brjod do// nyi ma gcig la sku 'bri ba nas bzung ste rab gnas dang bcas pa'i bar grub na legs so// gnyis pa sgrub pa dngos ni/ yod na sku gdung dang bcas pa'i mchod rten kyang bsham/ sngar gyi bris sku de shar phyogs su bkram/ de'i mdun du ba byung gis byugs pa'i maṇ+ḍa lar ri gling sogs kyi tshom bu so bdun ma bkod/ de'i mdun du mchod pa lnga/ dkar gsum gyi gtor ma gcig rnams rgya che bar bsham/ bgegs bskrad gzhi bdag la gtor ma btang bar bshad pas cha gsum yid ches nges shes pa btang bas 'thus/ gnas khang rten mchod rnams gu gul gyis bdug rang gos gsar pa gon cing*/ byung na theg pa chen po'i gso sbyong blang*/

de ma grub na'ang dkar gsum la sogs pa bza'/ rten la kha phyogs par 'dug rnam pa kun tu khrus dang gtsang sbra gal che/ grib la 'dzem/ bdag bskyed skyabs 'gro nas bzung ste bzlas pa dang*/ mthar mchod bstod 'dod don gsol btab kyi bar sngar gyi bsnyen pa bzhin bya/ skabs 'dir mchod pa byin rlabs spyi ltar dharmā ra ṇi ta lan gsum brjod pa'i bar byas la/ de nas rten ras bris la dmigs te/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ bris sku mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las mtha' thams cad rtsi shing rgyas pa'i ri bos bskor ba/ zhes sogs nas/ steng du lha'i bu gnyis kyis phreng ba 'dzin pa/ sprin sbubs nas byung ba'o// zhes pa'i bar bris sku 'bri thabs kyi skabs nas 'byung ba ltar ngag tu brjod cing bsam/ de ltar rten de nyid rje btsun 'khor bcas dngos su gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer byung ba bdag nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs kar phog pas 'khor lo g.yas dang*/ yig 'bru g.yon du 'khor te mi shes pa'i mun pa sangs/ shes rab kyi snang ba rgyas par bsams la thun bzhir sgom bzlas la brtson par bya/ thun mtshams rnams su mchod bstod maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de'ang maṇ+ḍal gyi gsol gdab/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi lha tshogs la dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas bdag gi mi shes pa'i mun pa sangs shing*/ shes rab kyi snang ba rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes sbyar/ shes shing nus na gang gi mchod rdzas ma'ang sbyar/ bstod pa'i skabs su paṇ+ḍi ta ma tis mdzad pa'i/ don zab sngags kyi stobs kyis sogs kha skong dang bcas pa byung na shin tu legs/ gtor ma chab kyis bran/ a kā ro lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/ oṃ wā kye daṃ na maḥ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ mchod cing bstod la 'dod don gsol/ sna ma'i me tog la sngags nas 'bul bar gsungs kyang bod 'dir dngos ma mi 'byor bas/

dzā ti'i phye ma dang me tog dkar po sngags dang sngags re dang bstun nas stong phrag gcig 'jam dpal gyi zhal la gtor/ yid kyis 'dod pa'i don la rtse gcig tu gsol ba btab/ mjug tu bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis bya'o// gsum pa rjes grub pa'i rtags ni/ de ltar byas pa'i bris sku las hūm̐ gi sgra'am/ ras bris 'gul ba 'byung ste/ hūm̐ gi sgras ni sa kun la dbang ba'i rgyal por 'gyur la/ ras bris 'gul na rgol ba thams cad la lan 'debs nus pa dang*/ rig byed kyi gzhung la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi bstan bcos thams cad shes par 'gyur ro// mtshan ma de gnyis ma byung kyang las thams cad la nus pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro// de yang rgyud las/ zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig gis dbyangs can gyi ngag thob par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pas/ zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig bsgrubs pas dngos dang rmi lam gyi rtags rnams yang yang 'byung zhing brtan par 'gyur ro// gal te ma byung na bskyar thang gcig gam/ gnyis sam ji ltar sgrib pa che zhing bul na'ang lan bdun tshun la rtags gnyis mi 'byung mi srid de/ spobs chog dang bcas pa'o// rtags bzang ngan gang byung kyang mi la mi bshad par gsang ba dang*/ ched 'dzin med par mi dmigs pa'i rgyas gdab par bya'o// de lta bu'i bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa'i sngags kyi kha skong ba'i phyir dang*/ dngos grub myur du 'grub pa'i phyir/ rgyud las/ gsang sngags ma bzlas mi 'grub cing*// sbyin sreg ma byas 'bras mi 'byin// bzlas brjod 'bum phrag gcig la ni// sbyin sreg khri phrag bya bar bshad// ces gsungs pa ltar bcu cha'i sbyin sreg bya ste/ de'i tshul ni 'jam mgon sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyi gsung rab ltar shes par bya'o// gsum pa tha mal las sbyor gyis rang gzhan la phan gdags pa'i tshul ni/ paṇ+ḍi ta ma tis/ snying dbus zla ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs drug la// 'bru drug yi ge bkod la g.yas g.yon bskor// shugs drag rtse mo rno zhing rab dkar bas// nyes 'joms stobs ldan myur 'dzin rab gsal 'gyur// zhes sogs nyes byas 'joms pa'i 'khor lo/

yon tan sgrub pa'i 'khor lo/ ral gri'i rig 'dzin sgrub pa/ sran ma mā shā la brten pa'i las sbyor rnams gsungs shing*/ de la brten nas rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus kyi yi ge las las kha tshar ba bzhi dang*/ chag lo gsum pa rin chen chos rgyal gyi yig char rgyud 'grel pa dang bcas pa nas kha bskangs te gnas skabs kyi las sbyor bco lnga bshad pa ni yig cha de dag dang*/ de gnyis ka'i don gyi bcud phyung ba 'jam mgon sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'i las tshogs rnams gsal bar bshad pa 'dod don lhun grub sogs las rtogs par bya zhing*/ gzhan yang*/ gzhung lugs 'chad pa na mgrin pa dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil par gyur pa'i nang thams cad ā li kā lis gang ba las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu'i rnam pa can 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi gsung gi ye shes rnams dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ mgrin pa'i ā li kā li la thim pas/ de las chos kyi sgra dbyangs rgyun mi chad pa lhang lhang 'byung bar bsams la 'chad pa la 'jug pas/ gzhung gang 'chad kyang thogs pa med pa dang*/ gdul bya la phan thogs par 'gyur ro// gzhan dang rtsod pa byed na/ rang gi lce shes rab kyi ral gri sngon po me 'bar bar gyur pa'i rtsa bar shes rab kyi ngo bo a yig dkar po las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu'i rnam pa can 'phros pas/ phas rgol gyi blo gros dang nus pa thams cad rdo khab len gyis lcags phye blangs pa ltar bsdus te rang gi snying gar thim pas sngags kyi 'khor lo gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur/ slar yang lce'i ral gri las de 'dra ba dpag tu med pa 'phros te phas rgol gyi lce nyal nyal du gtub cing lhag ma ye shes kyi mes bsregs par bsams la rtsod pas rang mi rgyal mi srid do// bstan bcos rtsom pa na/ bdag nyid 'jam dpal du gsal ba'i thugs dpal gyi be'u gser zhun ma'i mdog can du gyur pa'i dbus kyi khong seng du a yig dkar pos mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas/

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas/ so so skye bo shes rab dang bsod nams can thams cad kyi shes rab dang*/ yon tan/ nor bu dang*/ sman dang*/ sngags la sogs pa brtan g.yo'i dwangs bcud thams cad ā li kā li'i rnam par bsdus nas thugs ka'i sa bon la thim pas spobs pa'i gter chen po brgyad grol bar bsam la/ rig sngags kyi rgyal po bzla bzhin du rtsom na tshig don phun sum tshogs pas mkhas pa rnams yid 'phrog par 'gyur ro// mkhas dang grub pa'i zhal gyi lung*// zlam̐ shelam̐ bdudam̐ rtsi'im̐ snangam̐ ba canam̐// gang du 'char bas blo gros kyi// chu gter mchog tu rgyas par byed// de slad sa hā ka ra'i nags klung du// gzhan gsos lang tsho rgyas pa'i dbyangs snyan pos// mtshon min legs par bshad pa'i tam+bu ra// skal bzang yid kyi nyer 'tsho gcig pu nyid// gang las byung ba'i bsod nams dpag bsam gyis// sa gsum rmongs pa'i gdung ba kun bsal nas// rig dang brtse ba'i dge mtshan yongs rdzogs pa// 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i rnam thar 'dzin gyur cig /de ltar 'jam dbyangs dkar po ma ti lugs kyi bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i zin bris zla shel bdud rtsi'i snang ba zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ 'jam mgon sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'i bsnyen sgrub kyi yig cha'i lung rgyun mi bzhugs par brten/ yig cha de nyid kyi dgongs don gtso bor bzung ste rang gzhan rnams gyis nyams su blang bde bar/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga'i mtshan can sogs yongs 'dzin dam pa rnam pa lnga las tshul 'di'i rjes gnang dang*/ man ngag mang du thos pa'i shākya'i dge slong bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs bla ma dgyes pa'i 'bangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos sbyar ba'i dge bas 'gro kun so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyi snang ba mchog tu rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/

༈ /'jam dpal dkar po dpa' bo gcig grub kyi chos skor las/ bsnyen sgrub kha skong gi sbyin sreg ye shes 'od snang bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ bsnyen pa'i kha skong sbyin sreg gi cho ga la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ 'di'i bsnyen pa rdzogs nas dben pa'i gnas su yar ngo'i tshes grangs gza' skar sbyor byed bzang por 'dzom pa la/ rtsig thab byed na sa dkar po la las thams cad pa'i thab khung rgyar khru gang*/ zabs su khru phyed pa/ mu ran dang kha sgyer la sor bzhi pa/ pad+ma rgyas pa'i rnam pa/ kha sgyer ram mu ran la ut+pa la'i phreng bas mtshan pa bya/ dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar zla gdan la tshom bu dkar po sogs kyi mtshan ma bkod/ yang na de nyid bris thab byas kyang chog go /de ltar na ri mo'i dbyibs gsal ba'i phyir bcad tshon ri mo ni dmar skya'am ser po gang rigs kyis bya'o// kha sgyer gyi steng du yam shing gi rgyu la sogs pa'i bud shing khru gang gi tshad tsam brtsig de'i nang gi shar lhor ting lo mar kong che ba zhig bsham/ logs su dpal 'bar zhig dang dge 'dun gyi tshad mal sogs nas blangs pa'i me'ang sta gon bya/ thab kyi zhal nub tu phyogs par byas pa'i mdun du sgrub pa po'i stan nang tshang can shar du phyogs par bkod/ thab dang sgrub pa po'i bar du dkar zhal gyis byugs pa'i me yol bya/ 'di gangs ti ser bsgom rgyu yin/ rdo rje dril bu dgang blugs/ dung chos su dri bzang gi chu ku sha'i 'thor yab dang bcas pa/ thab tu 'bul rgyu'i ku sha'i chun po brgyad kyang bsham/ 'di gzhung las thab ku shas g.yogs par bshad pas de tsam ma grub pa'i dbang du byas pa yin/ rgyas par byed na/ rang gi g.yon thab kyi g.yas nas phar gtor ma gnyis chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod bsham/ rang gi g.yas thab kyi g.yon nas phar yam shing 'o ma can gyi shing sogs mthe'u chung gi sbom phra mtho gang gi tshad can gang dgos dang*/

rtsi mar gyi mar khu gsar pa dang me tog dkar po dug shing sogs ma yin pa dri bzang ba gang rnyed dang*/ dri zhim po ser pos kyang rung gsungs/ spro na bsreg rdzas sdig pa zhi phyir til/ bgegs gzhom phyir yungs kar/ 'byor pa rgyas phyir zas mchog bsod nams rgyas phyir 'bras so ba dang*/ 'bras/ shugs 'phel byed nas/ nad 'joms byed gro/ stobs 'phel byed sran ma/ tshe rgyas byed dūrba/ rdzas thams cad dag byed dam srung byed ku sha rnams kyang bsham/ bsdu na gong gi yam shing mar dang me tog gsum gyis chog go /thab kyi nye 'khor thams cad dri bzang pos byug rdzas rnams la'ang gtor/ 'byor na sgrub pa po gos rgyan dkar po bya/ 'dir me gso ba sogs pa la'ang kha'i phu sogs mi bya bar/ rlung g.yab dang rtsa skam pa sogs kyis gtsang sbra'i thabs mkhas dgos/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ snga dro'am dgongs ka gang rigs yin kyang*/ dgongs thun la 'jug pa dang*/ snga dro'i thun la grol bar mdzad pas/ dgongs mo'i dus su stan bde ba la 'khod de/ 'di ltar 'khor ba 'di sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho zad mi shes pa/ gting mi dpog pa/ thar dus med pa 'di las bdag gzhan sems can thams cad thar bar bya ba'i phyir/ sdig sgrib zhi ba dang*/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can rgyud la bskyed par bya'o snyam pa'i sgo nas/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te mjug gi mchod bstod kyi bar paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar nyams su blangs/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga ma grub bar lag pa gnyis pus mo las phyir mi 'da' ba la bslab/ dpal 'bar la gong du bshad pa'i me sbar te/ gus pa'i tshul gyis thab kyi g.yas nas zlum por bskor zhing*/ oṃ wā kye sogs yi ge drug pa lan gsum brjod/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ gyis thab kyi ting lo sbar/ rtswa skam po gzhan dang bcas te me sbar/ khu tshur gnyis bcangs pa'i mthe bong rkyong ba byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas dgang blugs bzung la/

blugs gzar mar dang bcas pas bud shing la khyab par blug oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ zhes brjod/ rang lha'i nga rgyal gyis bsang chu/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ nyer gcig sogs kyi byin gyis brlab/ ku shas thab dang yo byad rnams la gtor/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas rnams lha mnyes pa dang so so'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum la sogs pas byin gyis brlab/ thab bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis ye shes kyi thab khung dkar po zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa kha sgyer ram mu ran la ut+pa la'i phreng bas bskor ba nang ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bas gang bar gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ thab tu me tog cig phul la/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya staṃ/ thab kyi dbus su pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la 'khod pa ni/ me lha dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas bgrang phreng*/ g.yon ril pa spyi blugs 'dzin pa drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang*/ rtse mo ma nyams pa thab dang yo byad rnams kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ/ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin// dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// des bdag la gegs med cing zhi bar mdzod cig /oṃ badz+ra sa twa āḥ zhes brjod cing thab kyi mdun nas g.yas skor gyis phyogs mtshams brgyad du dgram/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas dgang blugs bzung*/

me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pas ram̐ bsam/ dgang blugs kyi gzar bu'i kha la'ang ram̐ bsam ste/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes lan bdun brjod cing mar blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la/ mthar oṃ ag+na ye ā dī byā dī bya mahā shrī ye ha bya ka bya bah+nā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod de gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la me lha'i zhal du phul/ de lta bu lan gsum gyis byon zan phul/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa'i mtshan sngags re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod/ dharmā ra ṇi bcas pa dang*/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs kyis bstod/ bsreg rdzas rnams lag pa g.yon du bzung*/ g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs te mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas dbul/ gong du bshad pa ltar bsreg rdzas rgyas pa yod na/ oṃ bo dhi bṛ k+ṣā ya swā hās yam shing*/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hās mar/ me tog ag+na ye 'ba' zhig gis 'bul/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+rā ya swā hās til dang*/ yungs kar/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hās zho dang sbyar ba'i zas mchog oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hās 'bras/ oṃ badz+ra bī dzā ya swā hās 'bras so ba/ oṃ mahā be gā ya swā hās nas/ oṃ mahā ba lā ya swā hās sran ma/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma r+yai swā hās gro/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu khe swā hās dūrba/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+rā ya swā hās ku sha rnams 'bul/ de yang sngags de rnams gsum tsam re brjod de byin gyis brlabs nas/ ag+nā ye/ 'ba' zhig gis 'bul/ gong ltar yang nyer gcig la sogs pa ci 'byor ba'i mthar/ bdag gis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba dang blo gros phun sum tshogs pa stsal tu gsol/ zhes pa'i spel tshig sde tshan re re'i mthar brjod/ mar dgang gzar gang thab tu blugs te/ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ me bsang sbyang*/
stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las rgya mtsho chen po sogs nas/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar bya/

skabs 'dir chag lo'i yig char/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur pa'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje bskyed la ye shes pa gzhug mchod pa 'bul/ zhes gsungs shing*/ 'di'i gsham du/ ye shes pa gshegs pa dang*/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu bar gsungs pas/ thugs ka nas/ mchod pa'i bar phyi mo rnams su mi snang yang gsar du bcug pa'o/ thugs kar shes rab kyi 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs drug pa'i lte ba la a/ rtsibs drug la mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du/ oṃ wā kye daṃ na maḥ zhes pa'i sngags kyi yig 'bru g.yon skor du gnas pa/ de'i thugs ka'i a yig las 'od zer 'phros pas rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs/ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya mañdzu shrī ar+ghaṃ sogs nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ gong gi dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ wā kye daṃ na maḥ 'ba' zhig gis mar bdun tshan gsum gyis byon skyems gong ltar phul/ mchod bstod sgrub thabs ltar bya/ rdzas rnams lha sngags snying pos bya ba ma gtogs 'bul tshul spel tshig rnams gong dang 'dra/ rdzas rnams kyi go don yam shing gzi brjid che ba'i ched du 'bul/ mar bdud rtsir gyur pa zhal du 'bul/ me tog mngar gsum dang mar khus nyugs pa dbu la phul bas dngos grub stsol bar bsam/ skabs su yam shing dang mar rnams me'i tshod dang sbyar la phul/ me tog kho na la grangs bzung ste/ lha sngags 'ba' zhig gis bsnyen pa gang song gi bcu cha 'bul/ rtsa rgyud las/ yam shing tshig pa'i me mdag tu me tog bsreg par bshad pas de'ang rung gsungs/ mthar na bza' ras dar gos sogs dkar po dang ja ci rigs pa 'bul/ slar yang mar bdun tshan gsum sngar ltar gshegs skyems su 'bul/ mchod bstod bya/ gtor ma gnyis chu gtsang gis bran/
