bsang sbyang byin gyis brlab/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi lan gsum gyis phul/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ brtse ldan khyod kyi mkhyen rab 'od zer gyis// bdag blo'i gti mug mun pa rab bsal nas// bka' dang bstan bcos gzhung lugs rtogs pa yi// blo gros spobs pa'i snang ba bskyed du gsol// rig pa'i gnas lngar sbyangs pa phul phyin nas// gzhan la 'chad pa'i spobs pa bdag la stsol// mkhas pa'i mdun sar rtsod pa'i grar zhugs nas// smra ngan pham byed spobs pa bdag la stsol// dpyod ldan mkhas pa kun gyis yid rton pa'i// sdebs legs rtsom pa'i spobs pa bdag la stsol// gnyis 'dzin mun pa 'thibs po mthar byed pa'i// sgom bral 'od brgya'i snang ba bdag la stsol// zhes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ yig brgya mang du brjod/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ badz+ra muḥs ye shes pa gshegs/ thab kyi rdul cung zad dpral bar byugs la/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ mar dgang blugs gang thab tu phul la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐/ me lha zhal phyag gi rnam par gyur ces brjod/ sngar ltar bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams bcu gcig sogs phul/ byon skyems ltar mar dgang blugs bdun tshan gsum phul/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs te mtshan sngags kyi mthar nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas phul/ mchod bstod dang*/ me lha'i rgyal po 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs nas/ kun 'grub shog gis 'dod don zhu/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// bsgrubs kyis bzhud cig byin za khyod// ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs// oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra gats+tshas me lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ rang gi gnas gsum bsrung zhing*/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis bya'o// me tog gi sbyin sreg nyin re bzhin drug stong bdun brgya re phul/

de lta bu zla ba phyed na 'bum phrag gcig 'gro/ de ltar lan bzhir bskyar bas 'bum phrag bzhi song na bsnyen sgrub kyi sbyin sreg mthar phyin pa yin zhes gsungs/ 'on kyang lag len sngar bshad pa ltar bde'o// phan yon ni rgyud las/ ji ltar rnyed pa'i me tog gis sbyin sreg 'bum phrag bzhi byas na/ gsung gi dbang phyug dang mtshungs par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so// 'jam dpal dkar po dpa' bo gcig grub kyi chos skor blo gros pad+mo kha 'byed ces bya ba las/ bsnyen sgrub kyi kha skong sbyin sreg 'di ni mi dbang rdo rje 'dzin pa sa skyong bla ma bsod nams phun tshogs kyis bskul zhing thugs dam du bstar ba'i ched du chos smra ba'i btsun pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis chos grwa chen po lhun grub steng du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni nye bar gnas pa shes rab lhun grub kyis bgyis so// shu bha mastu sarba dzā ga tāṃ// ༈ /'jam dpal dkar po dpa' bo gcig grub kyi chos skor blo gros pad+mo kha 'byed las/ las tshogs rnams gsal bar bshad pa 'dod don lhun grub bzhugs/ swa sti/ 'dir 'jam dpal dkar po dpa' bo gcig grub kyi bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ sbyin sreg dang bcas pa logs su rgyas par bshad pa ltar mthar phyin pa'i rnal 'byor las/ las kyi tshogs nyams su blang ba la/ rgya ston gyi yig char las kha tshar ba bzhi dang*/ chag lo'i yig char gnas skabs dang*/ mthar thug gi las sbyor gnyis las phye ba'i rnam grangs mang du bshad pa las/ dang po rgya ston gyis mdzad par las tshogs bzhir bshad pa ni/ nyes byas 'joms pa'i 'khor lo/ yon tan sgrub pa'i 'khor lo/ gzhan dang rtsod pa bya thabs/ sran ma mā shā la bsten pa'i las sbyor ro// dang po ni/ skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin las/ khyad par thugs ka'i 'khor lo shugs drag tu bskor bas snying rlung la sogs pa'i nyes pa 'joms so// 'khor lo'i rtse mo rno bar bsgoms pas blo rno zhing stobs dang ldan par 'gyur ro// 'khor lo'i gdan pad zlar bsgom ste/

gzhung las/ snying dbus 'dab stong 'khor lo rtsibs drug la// zhes sogs gsungs/ 'di'i bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin pa dag gis zla ba la sogs par 'bad pas gong gi phan yon de dag thob bo// gnyis pa yon tan sgrub pa'i 'khor lo ni/ mngon rtogs bsgoms la/ rang gi lce steng du a dkar po gcig bsam/ de las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drang*/ rang gi lce steng gi a la thim pas/ lus thams cad a dkar pos khengs par bsams la bzlas pa bya'o// 'di'ang lo zla la sogs par 'bad pas mi brjed pa'i gzungs thob par 'gyur ro// gsum pa rtsod pa bya thabs ni/ rang nyid 'jam dpal gyi nga rgyal brtan por byas la lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong la ral gri sngo sangs yu ba la as mtshan cing*/ gri rtse la me 'bar ba cig bsgoms la/ de'i a las 'od 'phros pas/ phyir rgol ba'i snying gar shes rab kyi ngo bo a dkar po la phog rdo khab len la lcags 'dus pa bzhin du tshur 'dus ral gri'i so la thim/ de rang gi snying gar thim pas/ kho'i shes rab rang gi shes rab kyi grogs su gyur par bsam/ gri rtse las me mched phyir rgol ba'i lce steng du phog pas lce thul gyis tshig par bsam/ de ltar byas na rang rtsod pa las mi rgyal mi srid de/ paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrīs mu stegs btul ba bzhin no// bzhi pa sran ma'i las sbyor ni/ 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i shes rab bskyed pa ste/ mā shā zhes pa mon sran gre'u yin pas/ de'i rigs kyi sran ma dkar po/ me dang mar nag sogs snum dang chus ma reg pa/ ma rul ba srin bu la sogs pas ma zos pa/ legs par smin pa/ mang nyung sngags kyi sgra zur la mi gnod tsam ji ltar rigs pa/ 'o ma/ mar/ mngar gsum mngar gsum ni/ ka ra/ bu ram/ sbrang rtsi gsum mo// dkar mngar gyi bdud rtsi lngas bran pa ma byung kyang skyon med gsungs/ ste bdud rtsi lngas legs par bran te/

bskams pa rnams dar dkar ram ras dkar srab mo dri ma med par dril te zla ba dang nyi ma gzas zin pa'i tshe/ rten gyi mdun du mchod pa bsham pa byung na legs/ sgrub grogs nyi zla la ltar bcug la/ rang mi lta bar ma grol bar du/ rang nyid bris sku yod na shar phyogs su bkram pa'i drung du kha shar du phyogs pas stan bde ba la 'dug bris sku med na nyi zla gang yin la rgyab gtad/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te sgrub thabs ltar nyams su blang*/ mchod bstod maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ grogs kyis gzas bzung ngo zer ma thag sngar gyi sran ma lce 'og tu bcug te zla nyi la mi lta bar rtse gcig pas sgom bzlas la 'bad na nus pa can la sran ma las myu gu skye bar bshad/ gang ltar yang grogs kyis gza' las grol lo zer ba nas bton te/ gos bkrol la sran ma myu gu dang bcas pa ba dmar mo'i 'o ma'am/ ra dkar mo'i 'o ma'am/ ma rnyed na chu gtsang ma khyor gang gis phul te sos ma reg par mid pas shes rab 'phel ba/ tshe ring ba/ skra dkar dang gnyer ma med pa sogs phan yon mang po 'byung bar bshad/ lan gcig la ma byung kyang yang yang bskyar ro// myu gu ma skyes na/ phye mar btags pa mi ma yin la sogs pas zin pa'i mgor sngags bzla zhing gtor bas gdon 'joms par bshad do// chag los mdzad par gnas skabs kyi las sbyor la bco lnga snang ba'i/ dang po shu dag gis glen dig bsal ba ni/ bsnyen sgrub las rung sngon du song ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ yar ngo skar ma rgyal la tho rangs nas mgo brtsams te/ de'ang*/ bris sku yod na tho rangs shar du dgram/ ma 'byor na'ang skyon med/ maṇ+ḍal mchod gtor rnams bsham/ sgrub pa'i skabs ltar/ bdag mdun mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul/ maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du shu dag dkar po'i phye ma ra ti gcig bzhag ste/ ra ti'i tshad ni gser gyi skabs na se ba phyed dang*/ man cha ni se ba lnga zer/ yang ba ru ra 'bring po gcig la zho gcig gi tshad du byas pa'ang 'byung*/

gang ltar yang*/ dang po ra ti gcig la cha bzhag la/ rtsa sngags brgya rtsa brgyad kyis bsngags te/ mar ram/ 'o ma'am/ zhun mar ram/ til mar dang lhan cig btung*/ de nas tho rangs re bzhin shu dag ra ti gcig lhag pa dang cher lhag pa btang ste goms su bcug nas/ de nas zho phyed du longs pa'i tshad ni paṇ+ḍi ta dā na shī las sran ma gcig yin gsungs pas/ zho phyed re la gong ltar bsngags te zla ba gcig gi bar du 'thungs na glen pa dag ni rig pa mchog tu 'gyur/ dig pa dang lkugs pa sel bar byed/ zla drug gis ni yon tan dpag med 'thob/ gnyis pa brah+mīs thos pa 'dzin pa ni/ brah+mī zhes pa/ brah+mā daṇ+ḍa'ang tshangs pa'i dbyug pa zer/ me tog gsum par grags pa'i sman blangs te/ sngar bzhin tho rangs bris sku la mchod bstod maṇ+ḍal sogs byas la/ sman gyi phyed ka byi la'i spar ba gang gi tshad tsam maṇ+ḍal du bzhag ste/ sngags brgya rtsa brgyad kyis bsngags nas/ zhun mar ram/ rtsa ba dang lhan cig btung*/ de ltar zla drug ma chag na/ dbyig gnyen sh+lo ka 'bum phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu thugs la bzhugs/ lta bur 'gyur bar bshad do// gsum pa sna ma'i me tog gis thos pa 'dzin pa ni/ dzā ti'i me tog gi phud bu 'bum dgos par gsungs pas bod 'dir mi 'byor ba'i phyir mi 'grub pas ma bris so// 'byor cing sgrub par 'dod na yig rnying chag lo'i yig char gsal/ du blta'o// bzhi pa sran ma mā shā'i las sbyor ni gong du bshad zin to// lnga pa ral gri'i rig 'dzin dang*/ drug pa phyag mtshan gzhan gyi rig 'dzin rnams ni re zhig las dang po pas mi 'grub pas 'dir ma bris te 'og tu blta'o// bdun pa mig sman chag lo'i yig char gsal yang rdzas rnyed par dka'o// brgyad pa thig le ni/ gi waṃ/ ldong ros/ gur gum/ tsan+dan dmar po rnams sbyar ba'i ril bu lcags gsum gser dngul zangs gsum ste 'di dag srab mor brdungs pa/

gyis dkris pa/ gza' 'dzin dus su sngar bzhin bsgrub/ dpral bar thig le byas pas rang sus kyang mi mthong ba'i mi snang 'grub/ dgu pa rkang byugs ni/ shing shal+mā li'i khu ba dang*/ dge 'byung gi 'grel par go ro tsa na zhes 'byung ba la/ bi bhū ti tsan+d+ras gi'u waṃ du bzhed cing*/ dā na shī la ni/ sngo go ban+da zhes pas me tog kha mthur du lta ba yin gsungs pas/ de rnams sbyar ba'i khu bas/ sngar bzhin gza' 'dzin gyi dus su bsgrub nas rkang pa la bskus na rkang mgyogs kyi dngos grub thob bo// de bzhin du mchil l+h+wam dang*/ shing l+h+wam la bsgrub kyang 'byung gsungs/ bcu pa dbang du bya ba ni/ pri yang ku'i me tog cha gcig dang*/ sih+la cha gcig dang*/ ru rta cha phyed dang*/ nā ga ge sar cha phyed dang gnyis kyi phye ma rnams byug rdzas dang*/ la bar+ṇa kho ḍī dang*/ nā gi dang*/ tsan+dan dmar po dang*/ ga bur dang*/ a ga ru rnams cha mnyam par sbyar ba'i bdug spos rnams/ gza' 'dzin gyi dus su sngar bzhin bsgrubs te/ gang dbang du bya bar 'dod pa de la byug rdzas kyis lus la byugs shing*/ bdug spos kyi dri tshor bar byas pa tsam gyis dbang du 'gyur ro// bcu gcig pa/ bcud len gyis tshe'i rig 'dzin sgrub pa ni/ ka ra dang bcas pa'i 'o ma'i 'bras thug gam/ ka ra dang zho bsres pa'i 'bras chan gyi snod lag pa g.yon par bzhag la/ g.yas pas bkab ste/ gza' 'dzin gyi dus su sngar bzhin sgom bzlas la brtson par byas pas/ rlangs pa dang*/ du ba dang*/ 'od 'byung ba ma zegs par zos pas/ lo lnga brgyar 'tsho bar 'gyur ro// rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan ni dur khrod du mi mgo gsum las sgyed bu bya/ de'i steng du skyes pa'i thod par tshil chen dang ro ras la me sbar/ bud med kyi thod pas bcad de dud pa blangs la snag tsha bzhin sbyar zhing*/ gsang sngags bzla/ des mig la byugs na 'jig rten gsum mthong bar 'gyur zhing*/

dpral bar thig le byas na bdag sus kyang mi mthong la/ rkang pa la byugs na rkang mgyogs 'grub cing*/ rdzas de gang la reg pa'i skye bo de bdag gi dbang du 'gyur ro// zhes bzhed do// rgyud las/ bcud len la sogs pa 'dus byas la bsgrub par bya'o// zhes gsungs pas/ bcud len gzhan rgyud 'brel las/ bdud rtsi bdun gyi sbyor ba sogs mang du gsungs shing*/ gzhan du gsungs pa'ang cho ga 'dis bsgrub par bya'o// zhes gsungs pas/ deng sang bod du lag len byed pa'i/ dngul chu'i bcud len dang*/ sngo rtag ngu dang*/ ra mo shag dang*/ da li dang*/ lug mur dang*/ dbang lag dang*/ me tog sna tshogs dang*/ chu dang*/ rde'u dang*/ cong zhi la sogs pa'i bcud len rnams kyang*/ sman sbyor rang rang gi gzhung bzhin byas pas/ cho ga 'di'i sgo nas bsgrubs na sngar ji skad bshad pa'i phan yon 'byung bar nges so// yang bsgrub par bshad do// bcu gnyis pa/ me tog gi sbyin sreg gis rje btsun gyi zhal lta ba ni/ rgyas pa'i thab ser po stegs bu gru bzhi pa/ logs rer khru bzhi bzhi yod pa/ dpangs su khru gang ba/ yang na bris thabs byas kyang rung*/ mu ran sor brgyad pa la rin po che'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ phyi rol stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i zur bzhir rin po che re res mtshan pa dang*/ thab kyi dbus su 'khor lo ser po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar rin po che'i mtshan pa/ phyi nang kun tu dri ser po dang*/ ba lang gi lci bas byug 'o ma can gyi shing gi bud shing brtsig yam shing 'o ma can gyi shing dbus kyi cha srid du khru gang*/ sbom phra mthe'u chung gi tshad tsam dang*/ bsreg rdzas gzhan rnams 'dra la/ khyad par du me tog pad+ma 'bum phrag lhag pa bzhag pad+ma dngos ma kong por skye zhes gsungs/ nya'i snga dro nas brtsams te sgrub pa po kha byang du phyogs/ bzang po'i 'dug stangs dang dga' ba'i yid kyis bya/ cho ga gzhan rnams sngar bzhin las/

me lha sku mdog ser po dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku mdog kyang dkar la ser ba'i mdangs chags par bsgom/ gtso bo'i sngags re dang sbrel ba'i pad+ma'i sbyin sreg 'bum rdzogs na bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i zhal mngon sum du mthong bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs/ bcu gsum pa bil

cho ga gzhan sngar bzhin las/ rdzas kyi gtso bo bil ba'i 'bras bu skyon med pa la bya ste/ rdzas 'bum rdzogs pa na gang 'dod pa'i rgyal srid thob par bshad/ ba'i sbyin sreg gis rgyal srid sgrub pa ni/ bil 'bras 'bum phrag 'byor dka' bas ma bris so// bcu bzhi pa me tog gi sbyin sreg gis ngag gi dngos grub sgrub pa ni cho ga gong bzhin las/ khyad par dri zhim po'i me tog dkar po'i sbyin sreg 'bum rdzogs pa na/ khyad par 'phags pa'i ngag gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro// bco lnga pa rtogs pa dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas 'bras bu'i sbyin sreg gis bu mo dgug pa ni ma bris so/ chag lo'i yig char bshad/ /gong du bshad pa'i lnga pa ral gri'i rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i rdzas ni/ zla nyi gzas bzung ba'i dus su/ ma yū ra grī ba zhes rma bya'i mgrin pa lta bu dang*/ su war+ṇa pār+ṇaḍi zhes pa gser lta bu ste/ khab len gyi lcags gnyis po gang yang rung ba las byas pa'i ral gri lag pa g.yon pas bzung nas/ g.yas pas lte ba'i 'thad du phreng ba bgrang zhing*/ sngar bzhin gzas bzung ba la mi lta bar grogs kyis brda sbyar bas/ kha shar du bltas/ mchod bstod/ maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas gzas bzung nas ma grol gyi bar du sgom bzlas rtse gcig tu byas pas ral gri las du ba dang*/ 'od dang me 'byung ste/ de nyid thogs pa tsam gyis nam mkha' la gang 'dod du 'gro bar 'gyur ro// yang gong du bshad pa'i drug pa phyag mtshan gzhan gyi rig 'dzin sgrub pa ni/ gser ram/ dngul lam/ 'khar ba'am/ zangs sam/ lcags gang rung las byas pa'i 'khor lo dang*/ sun nā ga'i shing ngam/ nā ga ge sar gyi shing las byas pa'i rdo rje dang*/ byang chub kyi shing las byas pa'i rtse gsum dang*/ smyug ma las byas pa'i mda' dang*/ ma dhu ka'i shing ngam/ bu ram shing*/ tsan+dan dmar po'am/ mya ngan med pa'i shing gang rung las byas pa'i tho ba dang*/

lcags brgyad lcags brgyad ni/ gser/ dngul/ zangs/ lcags/ rag gsha' dkar/ zha nye/ 'khar ba rnams so// gang rung las byas pa'i zhags pa dang*/ yang na de thams cad kyang rtsa ba wa dza las kyang rung ngo*// de bzhin du lcags kyu dang*/ chu gri dang*/ kaḍ+ḍa ra zhes ral gri sgur po dang*/ bhiṇ+ḍi pā wa zhes pa mtshon rtse gcig pa'am/ 'phong mdung dang*/ be con dang*/ mdung dang*/ mda' bo che dang*/ shak+ti dang*/ gtun shing dang*/ dbyug pa dang*/ gos dang*/ nor bu dang*/ rma bya'i mjug sgro dang*/ sder snod dang*/ gdugs dang*/ rnga yab dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ ut+pal dang*/ tā la'i 'dab ma dang*/ dgra s+t+wa rnams gang yang rung ba la gza' 'dzin gyi dus su/ sngar bshad pa'i ral gri'i rig 'dzin sgrub pa bzhin bsgrubs pas/ re res kyang mkha' la spyod pa'i rig 'dzin 'grub par 'gyur bar bshad do// de ltar na las tshogs 'gangs che ba 'di rnams tshogs lam chen pos gnas pa rnams kyis 'grub po// de ltar ma rig mun pa dpyis 'byin pa'i// lha mchog 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sgrub skor gyis// blo gros snang ba rgyas byed spel ba 'di// rang 'dod ma yin nan gyis bskul phyir sbyar// 'di la nongs par 'phags dang mkhas la bshags// 'bad pa'i dge bas ma rig mun sangs shing*// blo gros rab rgyas bsam don kun 'grub cing*// don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa'i 'byor gyur cig /'jam dpal dkar po dpa' bo gcig grub kyi chos skor blo gros pad+mo kha 'byed ces bya ba las/ las tshogs rnams gsal bar bshad pa 'di ni mi dbang rdo rje 'dzin pa sa skyong bla ma bsod nams phun tshogs kyis bskul zhing thugs dam du bstar ba'i ched du chos smra ba'i btsun pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis chos grwa chen po lhun grub steng du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni nye bar gnas pa shes rab lhun grub kyis bgyis pa'o// shu bha mastu sarba dzā ga tāṃ//

༈ /'jam dpal dkar po ma ti lugs kyi sgrub thabs bdud rtsi'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ sras bcas rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sku// 'jam mgon bla ma'i zhabs kyi pad+mo ni// dad pa'i yid mtshor rtag tu bsnyen byas nas// sgrub thabs bdud rtsi'i snying po cung zad spel// de la 'dir rjes su gnang ba thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa'i gang zag gis rje btsun 'jam dpal dkar po bsgrub par 'dod pas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul gsal btab la/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// lan ji ltar rigs pas skyabs su 'gro/ shes rab snying brtse dang bcas pa'i// brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas mdun du gnas bcas te// rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed bgyi// lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ don zab sngags kyi stobs kyis rab sbyangs pa'i// stong gsal nam mkha' dang mtshungs dri med ngang*// dam̐ yig las grub dkar dwangs bdud rtsi'i mtsho// gting zab yangs pa yan lag brgyad dang ldan// mtsho mtha' glang chen thal dkar gyis bskor zhing*// mnyen lcug 'khril ldem pad zlum drā bas khyab// lo ma'i khur lding dkar mdzes me tog las// yid 'phrog dri bsung ldan pas phyogs kun sgeg /mtsho chen dbus der pam̐ yig las byung ba'i// pad sdong yal ga lo ma phun tshogs mdzes// 'dab rgyas dkar gsal ge sar dmar ser can// lte ba ljang ser mtho ba'i dbus nyid du// a las cha shas rab rdzogs zla ba'i gdan// de steng rang sems a yig dkar po las// 'od 'phros don byas 'dus pas lhar gyur te// rgyal kun ye shes sku can 'jam pa'i dbyangs// zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi 'dzum mdzes pa'i nyams// phyag g.yas mchog sbyin legs par rkyong mdzad cing*// g.yon pas ut+pal sdong bu thugs kar 'dzin// me tog snyan gyi thad sor kha bye'i dbus// sher phyin stong phrag brgya pa'i glegs bam mtshan// rdo rje'i skyil krung 'od zer rab 'phro zhing*// dar dkar na bza' rin chen rgyan gyis spras// ston zla'i mdog can lang tshor ldan pa yi// snying dbus zla ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa'i// lte bar a dang rtsibs drug sngags kyis mtshan// 'khor lo g.yas dang yig 'bru g.yon 'khor bas// sgrib dag blo gros snang ba rgyas par gyur// oṃ wā kye daṃ na maḥ

zhes ci nus bzla/ thun 'jog pa na/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya mañdzu shrī ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas/ shab+da'i bar dang*/ ngo bo ma nor chos nyid rab mkhyen cing*// rnam pa ma lus chos can lhang nger gzigs// thugs rje che dang thabs tshul dpag med kyis// srid mtsho mtha' yas skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jam dbyangs mgon khyod gus pas rjes dran zhing*// sgom bzlas legs mchod mngon par bstod pa'i mthus// blo ngan ma rig 'thibs bu'i tshogs rnams kun// sprin med nyi shar ji bzhin dwangs par mdzod// ces bdag nyid la mchod cing bstod la gsol ba gdab/ 'di bsgrubs pa las byung ba yi// dge ba bdag gis gang thob pa// des ni skye bo thams cad kun// bde gshegs shes rab thob par shog /ces sogs bsngo smon bya/ thun mtshams thams cad du'ang rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi nga rgyal dang ma bral bas mtshan yang dag par brjod pa dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sogs bklag maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba sogs dge ba'i bya bas dus 'da' bar bya/ thun gang rigs kyi mthar gtor ma 'bul na/ gtor ma dkar zlum chab gtsang gis bran/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis byin gyi brlab/ rang gi snying ga na 'od zer 'phros pas rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ gyis gdan 'bul/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya mañdzu shrī ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ sngar bzhin mchod bstod gsol ba gdab/ nongs pa bshags/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis zla ba gcig du 'bum phrag drug bzla ba ni grangs bsnyen yin la/ de la brten nas bris sku sgrub pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga las sbyor gyi khyad par sogs ni gzhan du shes par bya'o// rgyud dang man ngag bdud rtsi'i chu gter che'i// snying po srid zhi'i gdung sel 'di sbyar bas// sa gsum rmongs pa'i mun pa rab bsal nas// blo gros snang ba mchog tu rgyas gyur cig

/ces pa'ang paṇ+ḍi ta ma ti'i gsung la skabs su babs pa'i tshig gis mtshams sbyar te 'jam dbyangs bla ma dgyes pa'i 'bangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos sbyar ba'o// shu bhaṃ// ༈ /'jam dpal dkar po ma ti lugs kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bdud rtsi'i sprin phung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yab gcig 'jam dpal dbyangs// gang des rjes bzung slob dpon dze tā ri// mkhas shing grub brnyes paṇa chen ma ti'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so blo gros snang ba stsol// bde ba'i rdo rje 'byung gnas sbas pa dang*// gangs can bstan pa'i nyi ma shākya shrī// mkhan chen byang chub dpal dang bde ba dpal// gsol ba 'debs so= /sangs rgyas gzhon nu bsod nams shes rab dang*// shes rab mgon po shar chen thams cad mkhyen// rgyal bas lung bstan kun mkhyen e waṃ par// gsol ba= /rgyal tshab dam pa yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel// dkon mchog lhun grub paṇa chen nam mkha'i mtshan// nam mkha' sangs rgyas nam mkha' dpal bzang por// gsol ba= /sangs rgyas phun tshogs bstan 'dzin lhun grub zhabs// dpal ldan chos skyong rin chen mchog grub dang*// 'jam mgon bla ma nam mkha' 'chi med la// gsol ba= /byamam̐s pam̐'i thugs rjes 'jam dpal gzhon nu nyid// kunam̐ dgam̐' bstan 'dzinam̐ rgya mtsho'i gtsug rgyan du// yongs shar bka' drin mnyam med bla ma rjer// gsol ba 'debs so blo gros snang ba stsol// de ltar snying nas gus pas gsol btab mthus// skye zhing skye bar theg mchog bshes gnyen gyis// rjes bzung tshul gnas thos bsam sgom pa la// g.yel med rtag tu brtson par byin gyis rlobs// khyad par bla ma mchog gsum gtsug tu bsten// smon 'jug byang chub sems kyis rgyud sbyangs nas// tshogs gnyis las 'khrungs 'jam dpal dpa' bo yi// zab gsal ting 'dzin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// thugs kar zla ba'i 'khor lo sngags phreng bcas// g.yas g.yon shugs drag 'khor ba'i snang ba yis// thog med rmongs pa'i mun pa kun bsal nas// blo gros pad+mo rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// tshad ldan bris sku'i cho gas dngos grub kyi// ye shes rang dbang nyid du sgrub pa dang*// nyes byas 'joms dang yon tan skyed pa sogs// phrin las 'bad med 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// mdor na deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar// 'jam mgon bla ma mchog gis rjes bzung nas// thams cad gzigs pa'i go 'phang myur thob ste// rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes 'jam dpal dkar po ma ti lugs kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa bdud rtsi'i sprin phung zhes bya ba/

byin rlabs kyi char chen 'bebs shing blo gros kyi pad+mo rgyas par byed pa 'di'ang thar lam bla ma la re ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos gsol ba btab pa sid+dhi rastu// sarba dā ka l+yā ṇaṃ bha ba tu// ༈ /'jam dbyangs dkar po ma ti lugs kyi sgrub thabs shin tu bsdus pa bdud rtsi'i yang snying zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ 'jam dpal dkar po bsdus te bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs sems spyi ltar bya/ oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las bam̐ pam̐ a dkar las// rgya mtsho'i steng du pad+ma zla ba'i gdan// de steng rang sems a dkar nyid gyur las// 'od 'phros 'phags mchod 'gro kun sgrib gnyis sbyangs// tshur 'dus yongs gyur bdag nyid 'jam pa'i dbyangs// zhal gcig phyag gnyis mchog sbyin ut+pal bsnams// rdo rje'i skyil krung 'od zer rab 'phro ba// dar dkar na bza' rin chen rgyan gyis spras// ston zla'i mdog can brgyad gnyis lang tshor ldan// snying dbus zla ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa'i// lte bar a dang rtsibs drug sngags kyis mtshan// 'khor lo g.yas dang yig 'bru g.yon 'khor bas// sgrib dag blo gros snang ba rgyas par gyur// oṃ wā kye daṃ na maḥ zhes ci nus bzlas mthar/ oṃ ār+ya mañdzu shrī ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā'i bar gyis mchod/ thal mo sbyar te/ ngo bo ma nor chos nyid rab mkhyen cing*// rnam pa ma lus chos can lhang nger gzigs// thugs rje che dang thabs tshul dpag med kyis// srid mtsho mtha' yas skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jam dbyangs mgon khyod gus pas rjes dran zhing*// sgom bzlas legs mchod mngon par bstod pa'i mthus// blo ngan ma rig 'thibs bu'i tshogs rnams kun// sprin med nyi shar ji bzhin dwangs par mdzod// ces bstod cing gsol ba gdab/ 'di bsgrubs pa las byung ba'i dge tshogs kyis// 'gro kun 'jam dbyangs go 'phang myur thob nas// srid dang zhi ba'i legs byas snang ba yis// phan bde'i pad+mo rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog

/ces pa'ang don gnyer can 'ga' la sman pa'i bsam pas slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i rgya gzhung sor bzhag ste/ mtshams sbyor cung zad bcas 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bris pa sid+dhi rastu// ༈ /'jam dbyangs dkar po sgrub pa'i skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i bstod tshig gi kha skong bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po ma ti lugs kyi sgrub pa'i skabs mdun bskyed dang mthun pa'i bstod pa ni/ paṇ+ḍi ta ma tis mdzad pa'i bstod pa las/ mu med 'od zer 'phro la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa yan dkyus ltar la/ de nas/ g.yas su kun tu bzang po nam mkha'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rnga yab nor bu bsnams// gang gis dran pas byang chub spyod chog gi /smon lam rdzogs par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// g.yon du spyan ras gzigs dbang zla shel mdangs// zhal gcig phyag gnyis rnga yab pad dkar bsnams// snying rje chen pos mtha' yas yid can kun// phan bde'i dbugs 'byin stsol la phyag= /steng gi nam mkhar chu 'dzin phreng ba'i dbus// 'chi med rigs kyi rig 'dzin gzhon nu gnyis// lha rdzas me tog phreng ba legs 'dzin cing*// mchod pa'i char chen 'bebs la phyag= /mdor na dad pa'i yid mkhar shar ba yi// 'phags pa'i zhing khams rten dang brten par bcas// 'jam mgon ye shes rol mo las byung phyir// rtag tu gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo// dpal mchog sku yi sogs sbrel lo// zhes pa'ang mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos gsol ba btab pa dge legs su gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ bha ba tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o//
